title: Facilities Maintenance Planner Scheduler
description:
This role will include oversight of all Equipment, Tooling, and Facilities preventive and reactive maintenance documentation requirements and work preparation activities. These will include initiating and expediting change controls, issuing and reviewing the completion of planned and unplanned work records, changes to preventive maintenance procedures, and oversight of the operation of the parts room. This person will work closely with the Production Planner, Maintenance Manager, Tool Room Manager, and Parts Room Clerk to schedule maintenance activities so that they minimize production downtime and take advantage of planned windows of opportunity. This person will also work closely with the System Administrator of IQMS (maintenance management system).

SHIFT: 7am - 3:30pm | Monday - Friday with weekends and overtime as needed


The following are responsibilities related to the Maintenance Planner/Scheduler Lead:

  • Maintain PM’s and the overall maintenance execution process including all SOP’s and WI’s through IQMS.
  • Work closely with the Production Planner, Project Management, and Facilities teams to schedule all maintenance work records (preventive and corrective) to minimize production downtime, take advantage of planned windows of opportunity, and ensure they are all completed on-time. This may include developing scopes of work and developing detailed plans to coordinate the work and in some cases project management of the work.
  • Provide PM (maintenance and tool room) scheduling to production planners at minimum 2 weeks prior to the month they are due.
  • Work with the Facilities team to ensure aging work requests are assigned and completed as soon as possible.
  • Review completed work records for accuracy and completeness of documentation.
  • Manage the storage of work order documentation.
  • Develop and maintain equipment and tooling information and history databases.
  • Work with Facilities Support to develop and track KPI’s and other metrics such as (but not limited to):
  1. PM’s completed on-time verses what is scheduled
  2. Downtime caused by breakdowns
  3. Actual Hours vs. Planned Hours for maintenance and tool room activities
  4. Maintenance Department spend
  • Create or modify preventive maintenance procedures to ensure that they are clear, complete, and accurate as related to the expected time required, and the quality of work performed.
  • Train and support maintenance technicians as necessary in IQMS to ensure work records are entered and completed as scheduled and are documented properly.
  • Develops workflows and drives an awareness and focus on safety including lock-out, tag-out programs, appropriate equipment guarding measures, and all other environmental, health, and safety programs.
  • Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and state, federal, and local laws.
  • Routinely reviews preventive maintenance program content and frequency.
  • Coordinate the creation and modification of accurate data records (equipment, BOM’s, counters, measurement points, maintenance tasks and maintenance plans), always focusing on “the best approach” philosophy and identifying site harmonization areas that need improvement.
  • Ensure proper change control processes are followed, and data is consistent with departmental and company standards.
  • Oversight of the efficient operation of the part rooms through IQMS and ordering system through SAP to include the direction of any Parts Room operation personnel.

Job Qualifications

  • Education requirement: High school diploma or GED required. Associates degree or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • 2-4 years of Preventive Maintenance and Corrective Maintenance operations within a manufacturing environment (plastic injection molding or high-speed manufacturing experience preferred).
  • An understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices compliance and systems.
  • Computer hardware and software applications including Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, a CMMS Program (IQMS PM preferred), and SAP
  • Business English usage, spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
  • Basic mathematical methods and practices.
  • Computerized Maintenance Management Systems set-up and operations.
  • Project management, organization, and communication.
  • Implementing practices for cost-effective management of resources.
  • Functioning successfully in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Analyzing problems, identifying solutions, and implementing procedures for resolution.
  • Responding to inquiries from management, employees, and regulatory agencies.
  • Communicating clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
  • Managing multiple projects, duties, and assignments.
  • Interpreting and applying federal, state, and local policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Managing, coordinating, delegating assignments, and reviewing the work of assigned department personnel.
  • Establishing and maintaining cooperative working relationships with others.
  • Incorporate process within the parts room to manage spare parts and incoming parts.
  • Maintain parts within IQMS to include locations and part numbers.
  • Communicate effectively with outside vendors.

7am - 3:30pm | Monday - Friday with weekends and overtime as needed

title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.


On AI

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.


What you'll do

Four areas, roughly in the order you will spend time on them. You won't work on all of them at once, but you should be open to any of them.

Product platform. Make the easiest way for product engineers to do something (the paved road, or golden path) also the most secure, reliable and scalable way by default. Build the shared primitives, libraries and APIs that hide complexity and carry our quality and observability standards with them. Own the architecture and the core stack: what gets standardized, what gets reused, and where the system should be in eighteen months.

Infrastructure, observability and reliability. Infrastructure as code by default, from cloud resources through to dashboards and alerts. Provision, run and tune our Kubernetes cluster and cloud footprint, and keep CI fast as the deploy rate grows. Define SLIs for the workloads that
matter, build SLOs on top of them, and make the alerting high-signal enough that people trust it. Drive down AI and infrastructure spend.

Security and compliance. Keep the internal foundations secure by default: IAM, dependency management, secrets. Own the authentication and authorization stack, including ReBAC models covering both humans and agents. Implement SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls without taxing every future change.

AI dev tooling. Keep product engineers and their agents on the paved road by making sure the documentation and agent guidelines they need are in place. Shorten the path from design to implementation with standardized automations and development environments that stay close to production.


What this looks like in practice

  • A system of record for managing and distributing constantly evolving agent configurations, under strict auditability and tenant isolation requirements

  • The harnesses powering our AI agents, abstracting over use cases that change faster than the code

  • Centralized progress tracking that holds up across a growing number of parallel agent executions

  • Usage-based tenant billing with quotas and rate limiting across a growing set of products

  • SLIs for the background job system behind our agents (execution latency, AI spend, memory, CPU), then fixing the bottlenecks they expose at both the application and infrastructure level

  • A document pipeline handling dozens of file formats, very large spreadsheets and hundreds of parallel uploads, under a strong reliability requirement


You will fit into this role if you…

  • Have designed, built and operated distributed systems end to end, and enjoy understanding how every part interacts with the rest

  • Are strong at backend software engineering and at DevOps/SRE, and don't think of those as separate jobs

  • Write design docs, RFCs, ADRs, postmortems

  • Reach for simple, boring solutions first, can tell essential complexity from accidental, and know which corners are safe to cut and which ones compound

  • Can turn a hard problem on its head and find the alternative nobody proposed

Concretely, you have scaled Postgres or another relational transactional database under real load, run production Kubernetes, and built observability rather than inherited it: SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing.

No one checks every box. If you have designed a system from scratch, run it in production, and can explain in writing why it is shaped the way it is, let's talk.


Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Durable workflow orchestrators like Temporal, and background job and queue processing generally

  • Infrastructure for LLM-based products or agentic systems

  • Audit, finance, compliance, or another high-accuracy domain

  • Azure and/or GCP


This is probably not the right role if…

  • You would describe application code as someone else's responsibility. A large share of platform work here happens inside the product codebase.

  • Your answer to reliability is more process. We want guardrails, not gates.

  • You need a well-defined system to work in. Ours is not one yet, and shaping it is the job.


What you will get

  • You own the brand and shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry. From Berlin, with AI at the core.


Interview process

  • First Call — Intro to Cortea with Liza

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Dan

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

title: Manufacturing Tech I
location: Rampart Operations Center, Birmingham, AL, US
description:
Job Title: Manufacturing Technician I (MT1)


JOB OVERVIEW:

The Manufacturing Technician I is responsible for executing defined manufacturing tasks in support of production operations. This role focuses on following standard operating procedures (SOPs), ensuring product quality, and maintaining a safe and organized work environment. The technician works under direction to support production processes and contributes to consistent, reliable output. This role reports to the Production Supervisor.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

➢ Consistently models the core values of the company both internally and externally.

➢ Openly commit to and support company processes and systems.

➢ Understand and follow the processes of the Rampart Quality System.

➢ Execute manufacturing and assembly tasks in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, and drawings.

➢ Perform basic inspections and record production data as required.

➢ Handle materials, components, and tools in a safe and controlled manner.

➢ Maintain a clean and organized work area in accordance with 5S and safety standards.

➢ Identify and report defects, issues, or abnormalities to appropriate personnel.

➢ Support production flow by staging materials and assisting in process operations.

➢ Adhere to all safety policies, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

➢ Participate in training and continuous improvement initiatives.

➢ Any other duty as required by supervisor.


Key Metrics

➢ Output Rate (Daily/Weekly)

➢ Basic Quality Compliance (Defect Rate)

➢ Adherence to SOPs


QUALIFICATIONS / EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

➢ Attention to Detail: Ability to follow instructions and ensure accuracy.

➢ Manual Dexterity: Ability to handle tools and small components.

➢ Technical Skills: Ability to follow SOPs and basic drawings.

➢ Communication: Ability to report issues and document work.

➢ Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

➢ Education: High school diploma or equivalent required.

➢ Experience: Entry-level or prior manufacturing/assembly experience preferred.


PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.


➢ Body Positions: Regularly required sitting, standing, and walking for prolonged periods of time.

➢ Body Movements: Full range of body movements including the use of hands and fingers, to handle or feel objects, including computer equipment and peripherals, and bending, reaching, lifting, and crouching.

➢ Vision: Ability to read and see instructions, computer screens, and small parts for assembly


MENTAL REQUIREMENTS


➢ Attention to Detail: Must be able to focus on small details and ensure accuracy and precision in the assembly of components.

➢ Relational: Must be able to comfortably connect and work with different personalities both inside and outside the company.

➢ Communication Skills: Must be able to read and write clearly to effectively communicate with team members and supervisors.


WORKING CONDITIONS


➢ Environment: Work is performed in a typical assembly shop environment. The area is usually well lit and ventilated but may involve exposure to moderate noise levels from machinery and equipment.

➢ Physical Demands: The role involves standing, sitting, and performing repetitive tasks for extended periods. Manual dexterity is required for handling small components and tools. Lifting and moving objects up to 50 lb.

➢ Work Hours: Full-time position with standard working hours, typically Monday through Friday. Occasional overtime or weekend work may be required to meet production deadlines.

➢ Protective Gear: Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, gloves, and ear protection is mandatory to ensure safety.

➢ Temperature: The temperature in the assembly shop may vary but is typically maintained at a comfortable level. Occasional exposure to cooler or warmer conditions may occur depending on the season and ventilation.

➢ Health and Safety: Strict adherence to health and safety guidelines is required to prevent accidents and ensure a safe working environment for all employees. Regular training on safety procedures and emergency protocols is provided.

title: Project Director, Re/Development
description:
The Project Director is responsible for leading the design, entitlement and execution of reinvestment projects, across multiple states within Brixmor’s portfolio. The Project Director will partner with the regional leasing, national accounts, and construction teams to implement value accretive projects across the portfolio. This position requires a proven track record in retail development / redevelopment, civil engineering, architecture or related fields. The Project Director will rely heavily on prior experience in managing consultant teams, directing entitlement processing, building strong interpersonal relationships through effective verbal written communication skills, professional judgment and confidentiality. The ability and willingness to lead projects in multiple Midwest / East Coast markets and regular travel are required.

Core Competencies:

  • Drive successful execution for assigned reinvestment projects, such as site densifications, outparcel developments and space reconfigurations. The successful candidate will possess the following key skills and competencies:
  1. Cultivate the project conceptual program - creatively initiate site planning, space planning and design development.
  2. Build the project team - identify, engage and direct third-party consultants and internal subject matter experts. Negotiate and administer contracts.
  3. Drive the development feasibility process – engineering analyses, zoning / code reviews, lease conflicts reviews, proforma financial feasibility analyses etc.
  4. Establish investment case, project proforma and investment committee materials in partnership with leadership and the asset management team
  5. Lead entitlement strategy and municipal process, including attending municipal meetings and hearings to procure all required project approvals
  6. Partner with internal leasing and national accounts teams to drive required lease commitments
  7. Accountable for project budget, project schedule, revenue projections and project return performance
  • Coordinate with leasing and construction teams from pre-dev. through project execution phase. Report on construction progress through project completion
  • Cultivate and manage tenant relations for assigned projects
  • Regular travel to assets/markets/tenants in support of assigned projects

Professional Experience & Qualifications:

  • 5 - 10 years combined, including development / redevelopment / entitlement experience.
  • Owner experience is preferred; however, tenant, owner’s rep. or similar development experience will be considered. Architectural / engineering / construction / legal/ project finance experience a plus.
  • College/university degree required
  • Proven track record in the entitlements process and consultant management
  • Bias for action and results. Willingness and ability to receive feedback and rapidly translate it into forward progress.
  • Effective leadership and communication skills. Ability to influence, collaborate with, and gain credibility among peers, staff, and leadership in the regions and corporate office
  • Drive to succeed and deliver results in a collaborative and cooperative environment
  • Relationships with national retailers, brokers, consultants and others in CRE
  • Knowledge and ability to review lease documents, Property Title reports and technically review plan sets (Architectural/Civil/Survey etc.)
  • Working IT knowledge and proficiency MS Project, Excel, Salesforce, BI, Co-Pilot / AI, MS Teams, Zoom, OneDrive and E-builder experience a plus
  • Knowledge of Adobe /Photo Shop/ Bluebeam or similar platforms a plus
  • Passion for real estate

Brixmor offers a hybrid work schedule (first three days of the week in the office, the balance remote optional), very competitive pay commensurate with background and responsibilities plus a benefits and perks package that supports career engagement, growth, good health and connection with teammates and our communities.

title: Sr Engineering Technician - 2nd shift

Your expertise will contribute to the evaluation and validation of aircraft systems and components, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance and safety. While performing operational testing on a variety of inertial navigation production this can be tasks including but not limited to: set-up, calibration, and testing and troubleshooting of instruments, DC circuits, assemblies, components, and other systems and equipment. In the Sr Eng Test Technician role, you’ll be critical to the successful production and technical support for our Engineering and other teams in ensuring our products achieve their intended functions and delivery schedule in a satisfactory manner to all of our customers.

You will report directly to our Supervisor and you’ll work out of our Clearwater, FL location on an Onsite work schedule.

Shift: 2nd shift with the possibility of rotating weekends

In this role, you will impact the efficiency and reliability of our aerospace products by conducting rigorous testing and analysis, providing critical data that informs design and engineering decisions.

  • Conduct tests on aerospace systems and components to evaluate performance and compliance with specifications.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and implement solutions based on test findings.
  • Work at a level of Engineering Troubleshoot and provide data for Failure Review Board (FRB) investigation.
  • Determines compliance to test specifications, using methods and procedures from drawings, standard work and diagrams.
  • May assist in the selection and set-up of specialized test equipment.
  • May provide guidance to entry level production test technicians and support workers in the execution of production testing tasks.
  • Measure medium complexity hardware.
  • Manage lab equipment inventory and provide feedback on lab improvements.
  • Document procedures and findings and effectively communicate these to key stakeholders.

Physical Requirements:

  • Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, small tools, or controls.
  • Reach with hands and arms.
  • Sitting. At times, looking through a microscope.
  • Standing or walking for prolonged periods of time.
  • Frequently required to stand; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
  • Repeat the same movements.
  • Occasionally lifting of light items weighing 5 to 10 pounds.
  • Make quick, precise adjustments to machine controls.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as an engineering technician or a similar role.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Active Security Clearance at time of hire.

WE VALUE

  • Strong technical background with experience in aerospace engineering processes.
  • Detail-oriented with good manual and eye dexterity (precise).
  • Experience in leading complex system integration projects.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Commitment to safety and quality assurance in all testing activities.
  • Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and embrace new challenges.
  • Willingness to take on diverse projects and work with different teams.
  • Strong knowledge of aerospace testing methodologies and standards.
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics.
  • Ability to troubleshoot at system level.
  • Ability to troubleshoot down to component level.
  • Perform test station assembly, qualification, troubleshooting and repair.

US Citizen

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual requirements.

title: DEPUTY BUILDING OFFICIAL
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Under general supervision, performs technical work in reviewing plans to ensure compliance with all applicable codes and inspecting new and existing structures for the issuance of permits in accordance with building and other pertinent codes. Work involves performing general clerical and administrative tasks in maintaining departmental operations. Serves as Deputy Building Official in absence of Building Official.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Reviews construction plans for compliance with building codes.
  • Inspects construction, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, gas, and Americans With Disabilities Act codes.
  • Conducts preliminary plan reviews with architects, engineers, and developers.
  • Interprets all adopted building codes, policies, ordinances, and procedures for the Inspectors, contractors, and the general public.
  • Maintains files and records of all building plans.
  • Assists Inspectors with specific questions regarding approval of plans, code requirements, and interpretation; conducts building inspections as required.
  • Researches on the Internet for updates on codes and manufacturer’s specifications.
  • Maintains a Town vehicle.
  • Keeps up-to-date with continuing education requirements; passes certification exams as required.
  • Performs general administrative/office duties as required, including typing reports and correspondence, entering and retrieving computer data, copying and filing documents, sending and receiving faxes, answering the telephone, establishing and maintaining filing systems, etc.
  • Receives and/or reviews a variety of reports and records (such as architectural plans, engineering plans, special inspection reports, energy conservation reports, and State laws).
  • Prepares and/or processes a variety of documentation (such as permit application, plan review letter, inspection deficiency reports, business license inspection forms, and written warnings).
  • Refers to building codes, manufacturer’s instructions, ordinances, State law, Internet, policy and procedure manuals, publications and reference texts, etc.
  • Operates a vehicle and a variety of equipment and machinery (such as electrical panel boards, HVAC and mechanical systems, plumbing systems, structural framing, computer, printer, wireless router, modem, etc.).
  • Uses a variety of tools (such as calculator, electrical analyzers, hand tools, pressure gauges, measuring tape, levels, standard office tools, etc.); a variety of supplies (such as inspection forms, writing instruments, paper, hard hats, flashlights, general office supplies, etc.); and a variety of computer software (such as Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, CitizenServe, ResCheck, ComCheck, etc.).
  • Interacts and communicates with various groups and individuals (such as Building Official, other Town personnel, co-workers, architects, engineers, contractors, and the general public).
  • Provides assistance to coworkers and/or performs those responsibilities as necessary to maintain standards of operation.
  • Maintains membership on local and Statewide group related to building.
  • Performs other related duties as required.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the essential job functions satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the primary job functions herein described.

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Must have State certification as a Plans Examiner and certified through ICC as a Building Official. Must have successfully completed required courses and certification; may be required to possess additional certification(s) as deemed necessary by the Town.


Requires an Associate’s degree in construction management, engineering, or related field supplemented by three to five years’ experience in all phases of the construction field or a closely related position; or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities. Must possess a valid South Carolina driver's license.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of the methods, procedures and policies of the Building Department as they pertain to the performance of duties of the Plans Examiner/Code Enforcement Officer.
  • Knowledge of the laws, ordinances, standards and regulations pertaining to the specific duties and responsibilities of the position.
  • Knowledge of structural, plumbing, electrical, mechanical, gas, accessibility, and fire safety codes.
  • Knowledge of modern office practices and technology.
  • Knowledge of and skill in the use of computers for records management.
  • Knowledge of how to react calmly and quickly in emergency situations.
  • Knowledge of the terminology used within the department. Has knowledge of proper English usage and basic mathematics.
  • Knowledge of how to personally demonstrate appropriate customer service skills.
  • Ability to conduct thorough plan review, note deficiencies and determine proper corrective courses of action.
  • Ability to perform fieldwork in uncomfortable physical conditions, including exposure to excessive heat/cold, odors, electrical currents, construction hazards, toxic agents, etc., and entering confined spaces and climbing to various heights.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with other Town and county departments, property/business owners, architecture/engineering/development and construction/real estate professionals, contractors, etc., in order to accomplish goals and complete projects.
  • Ability to work under stressful conditions related to balancing multiple projects within the constraints of time available.
  • Ability to react professionally at all times, dealing with sensitive situations with tact and diplomacy.
  • Ability to offer assistance to co-workers and employees of other departments as required.
  • Ability to take the initiative to complete the duties of the position without the need of direct supervision.
  • Ability to learn and utilize new skills and information to improve job performance and efficiency.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical materials pertaining to the responsibilities of the job.
  • Ability to prepare required reports and records with accuracy and in a timely manner.
  • Ability to maintain positive customer-focused relationships with co-workers, supervisors, agencies, the general public, and all other internal and external customers.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Tasks involve the ability to exert very moderate physical effort in light work, typically involving some combination of climbing and balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching and crawling, and the lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 20 pounds) and occasionally heavier objects and materials (up to 40 pounds). Tasks may require traversing uneven terrain during field inspections.

Health insurance

title: Spacecraft GNC Engineer III
description:
ABOUT

Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company on a mission to reliably and repeatedly launch, land, and operate space systems from Earth to the Moon and beyond. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the first commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the first company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.

SUMMARY

As a Spacecraft GNC Engineer at Firefly, you will design, analyze, and operate the GNC systems of operational spacecraft. In this role, you will develop GNC flight and simulation software, perform analyses, and support mission operations while continuing to build breadth across core GNC competencies. This position offers hands-on experience with spacecraft attitude determination and control systems, onboard navigation, sensor and actuator modeling, and real-time mission operations across multiple spacecraft. You will deepen your technical capabilities and refine your desired career trajectory, taking ownership of system elements and software tools as you grow toward a senior GNC role at Firefly.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and validate GNC software to ensure successful spacecraft mission execution
  • Tune and configure GNC algorithms for all phases of spacecraft flight
  • Perform 6DOF simulation analysis of nominal and dispersed flight profiles
  • Develop and maintain simulation models for sensors, actuators, and environmental effects
  • Create tools to automate workflows, process simulation and flight data, and generate technical reports
  • Conduct stability analysis, sensitivity studies, and hardware-in-the-loop testing of GNC under nominal and off-nominal conditions
  • Interface with cross-discipline teams to integrate GNC software with spacecraft hardware
  • Serve as a GNC console operator for spacecraft operations and perform post-mission analysis to improve spacecraft models
  • Author technical documentation and analysis reports that communicate GNC concepts and results to diverse audiences
  • Build proficiency across core GNC competencies while contributing to continuous improvement of GNC processes and tools

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, computer science, or related field
  • 4-8 years of professional experience in spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control, or related technical discipline
  • Advanced knowledge of spacecraft orbital mechanics, spacecraft dynamics, state estimation, attitude dynamics, and sensor modeling
  • Experience developing high-fidelity sensor and actuator models
  • Proficiency in a specialization of spacecraft GNC: Navigation, Guidance, Controls, Software Development
  • Proficiency in hardware-in-the-loop testing and requirement verification for mission-critical systems
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, data analysis, and visualization
  • Experience with C++ for real-time or flight-critical applications
  • Software engineering expertise with proficiency in development practices including version control, code review, testing, documentation, and CI/CD

Desired

  • Advanced degree (master's or PhD) in aerospace engineering or related field with focus on GNC
  • Experience supporting spacecraft GNC across development, integration, and mission operations
  • Expertise in C++ for embedded systems or real-time applications
  • Experience with modern flight software frameworks and real-time operating systems
  • Proficiency with CI/CD workflows and automated testing practices
  • Experience with Linux development environments and command-line tools
  • Exposure to spaceflight mission operations or spacecraft commissioning

Firefly offers outstanding benefits for our employees, including generous health, dental and vision plans with low plan deductibles, parental leave, educational reimbursement, short term disability, and flexible PTO options.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

title: Field Surveyor
description:
Louisiana Bridge Builders (“LBB”) is designing and building the new I-10 Calcasieu River Bridge in Lake Charles, Louisiana (USA) for the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (LADOTD). LBB will also be responsible for the reconstruction of interstate highway, various structures, ramps, and approaches for a 5.5 mile stretch between I-210 West End and Ryan Street.

Louisiana Bridge Builders offers a competitive salary, relocation assistance where relocation is required and approved, medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability, paid holidays, vacation, and sick time, and more.

Louisiana Bridge Builders is an equal opportunity employer.

Position Purpose/Summary

The Field Surveyor is committed to supporting Louisiana Bridge Builders by providing precise field measurements, construction layout, and quality verification essential for roadway and bridge construction. This role ensures accurate topographic data, alignment control, and progress monitoring to support construction crews, subcontractors, and project engineers.

Location

This position is based in Lake Charles, LA.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  1. Conduct topographic, boundary, and construction surveys for roadway alignments, bridge foundations, slopes, elevations, and cross-sections.
  2. Operate GNSS receivers, total stations, levels, and drones to collect accurate field data.
  3. Perform construction layout and stakeout for earthwork, structures, utilities, and roadway features.
  4. Monitor construction progress and verify compliance with plans, specifications, and right‑of‑way limits.
  5. Perform QA/QC checks on survey data, resolve discrepancies in real time, and maintain survey control networks.
  6. Process survey data using Trimble Business Center, AutoCAD, or equivalent software.
  7. Prepare as-built surveys, volume calculations, and digital deliverables (CSV, DXF, LandXML).
  8. Supervise and train junior survey crew members (2–4 personnel).
  9. Support machine guidance operations for dozers, excavators, and grading equipment.
  10. Maintain daily field notes, logs, and reports for engineers and project stakeholders.
  11. Performing all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Knowledge, Abilities, & Skills for Success

  1. Strong understanding of geodetic control, coordinate systems, and transformations.
  2. Ability to interpret engineering plans, roadway alignments, and bridge layout drawings.
  3. Proficiency with Trimble systems (R750, TSC7), GNSS workflows, and robotic total stations.
  4. Ability to work safely in active construction zones and rugged outdoor environments.
  5. Strong communication skills for coordinating with construction crews, subcontractors, and engineers.
  6. Ability to work independently and manage daily survey tasks with minimal supervision.
  7. Ability to adapt to changing field conditions and project priorities.

Qualifications

At a minimum, the Field Surveyor must have a valid driver’s license and ability to work outdoors in varying conditions. Experience of minimum of 5+ years of field surveying; roadway, bridge, or heavy civil construction project experience is preferred. Knowledge of machine control models, construction staking, and proficiency with AutoCAD or similar survey processing software.

title: Commercial Client Services Professional - Sterling Plaza
description:
External Applicants: Please apply through Prosperity Bank's Career Center at https://www.prosperitybankusa.com/Careers. Applying through any other source may prevent Prosperity from receiving your application.

Internal Applicants: If you are a current associate of Prosperity Bank, please apply through the internal Talent - Career Center in ADP.

Prosperity Bank is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


POSITION PURPOSE


The Commercial Client Service Professional (CSP) is the day-to-day liaison between our commercial banking clients and Prosperity Bank providing technical and operational support for our Treasury Services solutions suite and bank accounts. The CSP resolves client issues working across various departments and teams including but not limited to Treasury Services Operations, Deposit Operations, Loan Operations, Retail branches, Treasury, and Credit. The individual must be able to balance multiple tasks and priorities in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment. Expectations include adherence to the “sundown” rule for responding to clients, facilitating account opening, tracking incoming and outgoing requests, and maintaining department electronic files. Additional duties include in-person meetings with clients and prospects, projects as assigned, participation in the sales process, and other tasks as assigned.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES

  1. Interprets and resolves operational and technical issues regarding client bank accounts and Treasury Services
  2. Responds to all clients within three phone rings and updates the client on the status of all issues on a same day basis
  3. Inputs and tracks all operational/technical issues in the bank Client Service Team tracking system on a timely basis
  4. Adheres to the “sundown policy”
  5. Identifies and articulates opportunities to streamline and enhance the delivery of bank accounts and Treasury Services
  6. Facilitates bank account opening to ensure timely onboarding of Treasury Services and revenue generation for the bank
  7. Serves as a primary contact for the client
  8. Maintains current knowledge of clients’ businesses and the Treasury Services we provide
  9. Identifies and refers cross-sell opportunities
  10. Monitors accounts and services to ensure client satisfaction
  11. Makes in-person calls (frequently with Treasury Services Sales Officers) to develop strong client relationships
  12. Assist with special projects, data mining, analysis of client account, service, and activity


QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Certification:

Bachelor’s degree in Business or related degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience Required:

One year of experience in bank operations/commercial client service.

Skills/Abilities:

Understanding of cash management principles and practices.

Demonstrated willingness to learn, implement feedback, and act.

Ability to develop working relationships with clients/prospects and colleagues.

Ability to work independently.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong time management, organizational, and planning skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to use various PC and internet-based systems including but not limited to Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Strong cultural sensitivity and awareness.

Demonstrated resourcefulness and ability to research issues and conflicts for best resolutions.


PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS OF THIS POSITION

Talking:

Especially where one must frequently convey detailed or important instructions or ideas accurately, loudly, or quickly.


Average Hearing:

Able to hear average or normal conversations and receive ordinary information.


Repetitive Motion:

Movements frequently and regularly required using the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.


Average Visual Abilities:

Average, ordinary, visual acuity necessary to prepare or inspect documents or products, or operate machinery.


Physical Strength:

Sedentary work; sitting most of the time. Exerts up to 10 lbs. of force occasionally. (Almost all office jobs.)


WORKING CONDITIONS

None: No hazardous or significantly unpleasant conditions (such as in a typical office).

MENTAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS OF THIS POSITION

Ability to apply logical or scientific thinking to define problems, collect data establish facts, and draw conclusions.

Able to interpret a variety of technical instructions and can deal with multiple variables.

title: Field Technician
description:
Field Technician

Maryland Energy Advisors (MDEA) is a rapidly growing energy management firm delivering energy efficiency and sustainability programs for utilities and communities across the region. As part of our continued expansion, we are seeking a qualified Home Energy Auditor to support residential energy efficiency and home weatherization programs throughout New Jersey.

In this role, you will conduct in-home energy assessments for income-qualified and residential customers, identifying energy-saving opportunities, educating homeowners, and supporting the delivery of utility-funded energy efficiency measures. You will work closely with program managers, field services staff, contractors, and utility partners to ensure audits are completed accurately, safely, and in compliance with program guidelines and quality standards.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable working in the field. Strong communication skills, technical aptitude, and a commitment to delivering a positive customer experience are essential. If you enjoy hands-on work, problem-solving, and making a tangible impact on household energy affordability and comfort, this is an excellent opportunity to grow with a mission-driven organization supporting New Jersey communities.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the day-to-day operations of a residential utility energy efficiency and home weatherization program, ensuring high-quality service delivery and a positive customer experience for eligible households.
  • Generate and manage audit leads through door-to-door outreach and community-based engagement within assigned neighborhoods, representing the program professionally and in alignment with utility guidelines.
  • Perform in-home and visual energy assessments of residential properties, evaluating HVAC systems, windows, doors, insulation, appliances, lighting, and other building components to identify energy efficiency opportunities.
  • Educate residents on household energy use, comfort, health, and safety, and provide clear guidance on practical actions and utility incentives that can reduce energy costs.
  • Prepare and deliver energy assessment reports with personalized recommendations, ensuring accurate documentation and data entry in program tracking systems.
  • Install eligible no-cost or low-cost direct-install energy-saving measures in accordance with program requirements and safety protocols.
  • Introduce and refer residents to additional utility-sponsored programs and services, supporting increased program participation and comprehensive energy savings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the successful execution of program field operations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 1 year of professional experience in residential energy auditing, building science, weatherization, or utility-funded energy efficiency programs.
  • Strong knowledge of residential energy audits, weatherization practices, and direct-install energy efficiency measures.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and educate customers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to respond to field-based challenges with professionalism and sound judgment.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively as part of a field services team.
  • Comfort using technology, including handheld data collection devices, mobile applications, and program tracking systems.
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements of the role, including bending, stooping, reaching, climbing stairs, and working in various residential environments.
  • Flexible availability, including occasional evenings and weekends based on customer and program needs.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check and drug screening, as required by utility and program partners.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BPI certification preferred. If not currently certified, MDEA will provide training and support to obtain BPI certification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Energy, Environmental Studies, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Experience supporting utility-sponsored energy efficiency or demand response programs for utilities, state or local governments, or nonprofit organizations.
  • Prior experience with door-to-door outreach, customer acquisition, or lead generation in residential settings.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish or other languages commonly spoken in New Jersey communities) is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with New Jersey Clean Energy or other regional home weatherization and residential energy efficiency programs.
  • Strong time-management skills and demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of field activities across multiple neighborhoods.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This position is primarily field based, with most of the time spent conducting in-home energy audits and assessments at residential properties.

  • Auditors work independently in customers’ homes across assigned service territories, traveling daily between audit locations.
  • Work is performed in a variety of residential settings and may involve basements, attics, crawlspaces, and utility rooms.
  • This role requires regular interaction with homeowners and occupants, emphasizing professionalism, safety, and customer service.
  • Limited administrative and reporting tasks are completed remotely or from home using mobile and cloud-based program systems.
  • Work schedules may include occasional evenings or weekends to accommodate customer availability and program needs.

BENEFITS

MD Energy Advisors offers competitive salaries and benefits. We put a premium on work-life balance, offering flexibility with our remote team. We also offer:

  • Medical, dental and vision health insurance
  • 401k
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Great company culture with outstanding growth opportunity

Maryland Energy Advisors is an Equal Opportunity Employer/M/F/Disability/Vet.

title: Head of Programmes (P)
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process.

For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates:

  1. Internal candidates
  2. Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu

Second tier candidates include:
All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM.

Organizational Context and Scope

Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Mission (COM), the Head of Programmes will oversee the strategic development, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of all Country Office (CO) programme activities, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, donor requirements, and national strategies.

  1. Oversee the overall development, implementation, and monitoring of programme activities under areas of responsibility. Identify potential and existing obstacles to programme delivery, through continuous monitoring of new programme areas that reflect changes in host country and donor priorities.
  2. Develop the CO’s programme overview, including all programmes implemented by the CO and identify key programme milestone and major activities to inform the COM’s planning and decision-making.
  3. Contribute actively, in coordination with the relevant units, in the conceptualization and development of new programme actions in line with IOM Colombia strategic priorities, which are in line with IOM’s global & regional strategies, the Country National Peace & Development Strategy, and the UN 80 / Humanitarian Reset process.
  4. Support the Chief of Mission and CO’s relevant units in targeted fundraising efforts for new project initiatives; identify synergies with IOM’s programmes and make recommendations on donor/partner engagement.
  5. Oversee the preparation of all narrative and financial reporting, both internal and external, ensuring quality of inputs in line with IOM and donor requirements.
  6. Guide Programme Officers on project development, public information, donor relations, government liaison and information management; to ensure consistency and coherence of project/programme activities in accordance with the CO’s strategies and in coordination with the RO and relevant departments/units at Headquarters (HQ).
  7. Provide guidance and support to the Heads of Sub-Offices on the CO’s priorities, policies and strategies.
  8. Ensure the Programme implementation reflects current best practices and IOM’s policies and instructions, as advised by relevant technical experts and divisions, and contribute to policy development by preparing policy inputs and sharing lessons learned derived from Programme implementation.
  9. Ensure Programme compliance with IOM’s project management policies, including HR, financial management, donor reporting, and risk management.
  10. Identify programme strategic priorities in relevant service areas and areas of interest in line with IOM mandate and expertise, contributing to further expand the CO’s partnership basis and the scope of activities.
  11. Support creation of a culture of monitoring, evaluation and learning within the Programme. Encourage identification of lessons learned and best practices, promote action-oriented research, and facilitate real-time incorporation of knowledge and learning into Programme implementation.
  12. Perform such other duties as may be assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Master’s degree in International Studies or a related field from an accredited academic institution with seven years of relevant professional experience; or,
  • University degree in the above fields with nine years of relevant professional experience.

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Given the financial and operational complexity context in Colombia, and the need for continuous engagement with donor counterparts, the candidate must demonstrate experience in establishing and maintaining high-level relationships with government authorities (at ministerial and vice-presidential levels), diplomatic missions, donors, international organizations, Non-Government Organizations (NGOs), the UN Country Team, the private sector, and the media;
  • Demonstrated managerial experience in staff management;
  • Field work experience in conflict/post-conflict assistance (reintegration of ex-combatants, comprehensive assistance to victims - including Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs), returnees and former child combatants), emergency response and rural development;
  • Experience in coordinating the implementation of shelter and Non-Food Items (NFI), community stabilization, livelihoods and integration, and return and reconciliation;
  • Experience with developing and implementing regular pathways strategics, programmes and solutions;
  • Experience in project development, implementation, and reporting, including financial and budgetary aspects;
  • Experience working in project development in developing countries in Latin America with governmental or international Organisations;
  • Experience in coordinating and implementing interagency UN cooled mechanism related to migration flows; and,
  • Experience in the design, negotiation and implementation on government funded project.

Skills

  • Demonstrated knowledge in inter-agency programme regulations of the UN and other donors;
  • In depth knowledge of the broad range of migration related subject areas dealt with by the Organization;
  • Sound judgment, ability to analyze information and make decisions rapidly to resolve operational problems;
  • Efficiency, flexibility, high level of professionalism and ability to adhere to strict deadlines;
  • Demonstrated leadership, management, and coordination capacity;
  • Sound communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work effectively and harmoniously with colleagues from varied cultures and backgrounds;
  • Advanced computer skills, and proficiency in spreadsheet and database applications;
  • Familiarity with IOM’s MiMOSA and PRIMA systems;
  • Knowledge of the IOM project management cycle; and,
  • Knowledge of IOM’s administrative and financial management.

Languages

IOM’s official languages are English, French and Spanish. All staff members are required to be fluent in one of the three languages.

For this position, fluency in English and Spanish are required (oral and written).

Working knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, and Russian) is an advantage.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.


Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 3

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.


Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 3

  • Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
  • Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
  • Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
  • Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
  • Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.


Notes

Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.

Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security as well as accreditation, any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.

IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.

IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

  • Collaborate with internal team members to understand program technical scope.
  • Participate in internal technical discussions and training sessions.

  • Basic understanding of engineering principles, testing procedures, and laboratory practices.
  • Familiarity with Windows operating systems and internal data acquisition systems.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Applications.

With operations spanning more than 35 countries, we’ve proudly been nourishing families for over 135 years.


Our company is committed to maintaining a safe and productive work environment. As a drug free workplace, all candidates selected for hire in our operations, warehouse, quality assurance, transportation and production roles must complete and pass a pre-employment drug test.

Purpose of Position:


Del Monte Foods is the Foods Division of Fresh Del Monte, a global grower, producer and marketer of fresh, value-added, and shelf-stable produce. Del Monte Foods has a powerful portfolio of brands, including the iconic Del Monte®, Contadina® and S&W®.

Del Monte Foods (DMC Foods Inc.), the Foods Division of Fresh Del Monte, is seeking a Seasonal Harvester Operator. The Seasonal Harvester Operator is responsible for operating harvesting equipment to support efficient field operations during the harvest season. This position works closely with field leadership and other harvest employees to maximize harvesting efficiency, maintain equipment safety, and support crop quality. The Seasonal Harvester Operator is expected to follow all company safety rules, maintain productivity standards, and assist with additional harvest activities as needed throughout the season. This seasonal role typically runs from mid-June through October.


Range of pay for this role is dependent on prior experience working with our field team. Pay range is $18.05-$19.95.


Accountabilities:

  • Operate harvester equipment safely and efficiently during harvest activities.
  • Transport harvesters between fields and work locations while following all company and roadway safety requirements.
  • Support field operations by maintaining efficient picking and harvesting performance.
  • Assist with unjamming harvesters, troubleshooting minor operational issues, and cleaning debris or spilled beans around trucks and harvesters as needed.
  • Monitor harvester performance during operation and report equipment issues or safety concerns to leadership.
  • Work closely with other harvester operators, drivers, and field personnel to maintain smooth harvest operations.
  • Assist with training and supporting new employees as requested.
  • Follow all company policies related to safety, food safety, quality, environmental compliance, and employee conduct.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area in and around harvesting equipment.
  • Support additional field department duties and seasonal activities as assigned.
  • Work overtime, weekends, and varying schedules as needed based on harvest demands and weather conditions.


Incentives:

  • The Harvest Operator position may qualify for an Attendance Bonus by maintaining positive attendance.


Minimum Skills Required:

  • Ability to safely operate harvesters and other farm equipment.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Strong attendance, dependability, and work ethic.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with coworkers and supervisors in a team environment.
  • Ability to recognize and report unsafe conditions or equipment issues.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to safely climb ladders and enter/exit harvester cabs multiple times throughout the day.
  • Ability to walk in uneven outdoor field conditions and varying weather environments.
  • Ability to perform physical work, including bending, climbing, lifting, and standing for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, overtime, weekends, and holidays during harvest season.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Previous experience operating harvesters, tractors, or other agricultural equipment.
  • Previous experience working in farming, harvesting, field operations, or outdoor labor environments.
  • Knowledge of safe equipment operation and preventative maintenance practices.
  • Experience training or assisting other employees in a seasonal work environment.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and ability to identify minor equipment issues.
  • Equivalent combinations of education, agricultural experience, farm equipment operation, military experience, or related work experience may be considered in place of direct harvester operation experience.
  • Must be able to effectively read, write, speak, and understand English in order to perform the essential functions of the position.



***Please note: This position does not qualify for relocation expenses.***


Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc. is a global leader in the production, distribution, and marketing of fresh and freshcut fruits and vegetables. Our diverse product portfolio also includes prepared fruits and vegetables, juices, beverages, snacks, and desserts—available in over 80 countries worldwide. With operations spanning more than 35 countries, we’ve proudly been nourishing families for over 135 years.


We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fresh Del Monte and its affiliates do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, gender, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also participate in E-Verify* where applicable, to ensure employment authorization eligibility. Driven by our core values—Excellence, Care, Passion, Trust, and Creativity—we invite you to explore our career opportunities and join our FRESH team.

title: Computer Engineer
description:
Responsible for supporting the design, implementation, integration, testing, maintenance and optimisation of technology systems and digital solutions across the organisation. The role works closely with IT, engineering disciplines, BIM/digital engineering, project controls, project management teams and external technology providers to deliver reliable, secure and efficient solutions. The position contributes to systems integration, application support, automation, cloud technologies, data management, digital engineering and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support cost-effective implementation and optimisation of systems and technology solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs through automation, system integration and process improvement.
  • Provide technical input into the evaluation and selection of software, hardware and technology solutions.
  • Support vendor evaluations, technical assessments and procurement activities.
  • Maximise utilisation and value from existing technology investments.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate duplicate systems, manual processes and inefficient technology practices.

Key Responsibilities (Customer Focus)

  • Understand user and project requirements and translate them into practical technology solutions.
  • Provide timely technical support to internal users and project teams.
  • Investigate and resolve system, application, integration and connectivity issues.
  • Maintain a customer-focused approach when delivering systems and technical support.
  • Support system demonstrations, user training and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Gather user feedback and recommend improvements to enhance system functionality and user experience.
  • Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities (Internal Business Process)

  • Support the design, configuration, implementation and maintenance of business and engineering systems.
  • Analyse technical and functional requirements and develop appropriate system solutions.
  • Support integration between ERP, BIM, GIS, CDE, document management, project controls and other enterprise/project systems.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, interfaces, data exchange mechanisms and automated workflows.
  • Provide application and technical support and perform root-cause analysis of system issues.
  • Monitor system performance, availability and capacity.
  • Prepare system specifications, technical documentation, workflows and solution designs.
  • Support system upgrades, enhancements, migrations and deployments.
  • Prepare test plans, test cases and test scenarios and support system integration testing and UAT.
  • Support automation initiatives using scripting, workflows, Power Platform or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure solutions comply with IT governance, cybersecurity, data protection and information security requirements.
  • Coordinate with software vendors, consultants and system integrators.
  • Support proof-of-concept and pilot projects involving AI, cloud, IoT, digital twins, automation and data analytics.
  • Maintain accurate system configuration, technical and operational documentation.

Key Responsibilities (Learning & Growth)

  • Keep abreast of emerging technologies and trends relevant to engineering and infrastructure organisations.
  • Continuously develop knowledge of cloud technologies, systems integration, automation, AI, BIM, GIS and digital engineering.
  • Participate in relevant technical training, certification programmes and professional development activities.
  • Share technical knowledge, lessons learned and best practices with colleagues and project teams.
  • Participate in technology pilots, proof-of-concept initiatives and innovation programmes.
  • Develop the capability to evaluate and implement new technology solutions effectively.
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the COE.

Qualification, Technical Skills and Competencies

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree is desirable.
  • Relevant professional certifications in cloud, networking, cybersecurity, systems administration or application technologies are advantageous.Certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, Azure, AWS, Cisco or VMware would be beneficial.
  • Computer systems and architecture; systems integration; application and systems administration; APIs and web services; database technologies and SQL; networking fundamentals; cloud platforms such as Azure/AWS/GCP; Microsoft 365; enterprise applications; data management and integration; Power Platform/workflow automation; scripting; BIM/CDE and digital engineering systems; GIS; cybersecurity fundamentals; system monitoring and troubleshooting; virtualisation technologies; AI and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; technical troubleshooting; systems thinking; attention to detail; stakeholder management; customer-service orientation; strong communication and interpersonal skills; project and time management; strong documentation skills; ability to work across multidisciplinary teams; ability to learn new technologies quickly; continuous improvement mindset; ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Overall Experience Required to Execute this Role

10–12 years of relevant professional experience in computer engineering, systems engineering, IT infrastructure, systems integration, application support, digital solutions or a related technology field. Experience in an engineering consultancy, construction, infrastructure or project-based organisation is highly desirable.

Specific Experience Required to Execute this Role

  • Proven hands-on experience in systems implementation, integration and technical support.
  • Experience with enterprise and project-based applications.
  • Practical experience integrating systems using APIs, databases or middleware.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and modern IT environments.
  • Experience in application troubleshooting, system monitoring and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience supporting software implementation, upgrades and migrations.
  • Experience with data integration, automation and workflow solutions.
  • Experience with BIM, CDE, GIS, ERP or project management systems is advantageous.
  • Experience coordinating with software vendors, consultants and system integrators.
  • Exposure to AI, IoT, digital twins and data analytics is desirable.
  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary engineering or infrastructure projects is an advantage.

title: Technical Designer
description:
Position Summary

The Technical Designer will support the US Wholesale Product Development team with a primary focus on Walmart. This role is responsible for ensuring fit, construction, quality, and compliance from concept through production. The ideal candidate has deep experience in mass retail, strong technical expertise, and the ability to partner cross-functionally with Design, Production, Merchandising, and overseas vendors to meet aggressive timelines and cost targets.

This role is hands-on and fast-paced, requiring a strong understanding of Walmart standards, fit consistency, and production readiness at scale.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Design & Fit

  • Own fit and construction for assigned categories, ensuring consistency across styles and size ranges
  • Lead fit sessions (in-person and virtual), provide clear fit comments, and track revisions through approval
  • Review and approve samples from proto through PP and TOP
  • Ensure all garments meet Walmart fit, quality, and compliance standards

Product Development & Production Support

  • Partner closely with Design and Production to ensure styles are engineered for cost, quality, and manufacturability
  • Provide technical guidance on pattern corrections, grading, construction methods, and fabric performance
  • Review and approve tech packs, specs, BOMs, and measurement standards
  • Support vendor communication by providing detailed, actionable feedback

Compliance & Quality

  • Identify potential quality or production risks early and recommend solutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a technical liaison between internal teams and overseas vendors


Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of Technical Design experience in apparel, with strong mass retail and Walmart-specific experience
  • Deep understanding of fit, grading, pattern development, and garment construction
  • Experience supporting high-volume US Wholesale programs

  • Ability to manage multiple styles and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in PLM systems, Adobe Illustrator, Excel, and technical documentation
  • Experience working with overseas vendors (Asia, Central America, etc.)


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with licensed apparel programs
  • Multi-category experience (knits, wovens, fleece, activewear, etc.)
  • Prior experience in a vertical or fast-paced private-label environment
