title: Senior / Lead Data Engineer
description:
Chi siamo

SkillSherpa è una società svizzera che opera nel ramo workforce analytics e human capital intelligence, la nostra missione è quella di fornire ai nostri clienti soluzioni all’avanguardia in grado di contribuire a migliorare il loro business attraverso l’uso intelligente dei dati. Il nostro ufficio è a Chiasso (Svizzera), a 1 minuto a piedi dalla stazione dei treni.

Descrizione del ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior / Lead Data Engineer da inserire nel nostro team Dati. Il candidato selezionato avrà un ruolo cruciale nella progettazione, sviluppo e gestione dell'infrastruttura dati, consentendo al nostro team di espandere le soluzioni di analisi dati ed AI/ML in uso e crearne di nuove.

Responsabilità principali

  • Progettare, implementare e gestire l'infrastruttura dati su Google Cloud, includendo le integrazioni necessarie per le piattaforme di produzione tramite Federated Identities o approcci simili;
  • Sviluppare pipeline ETL ed ELT utilizzando Google Cloud Composer, Google BigQuery e Python;
  • Implementazione di processi spot di estrazione dati ad-hoc tramite SQL o Python;
  • Garantire la sicurezza dell'infrastruttura dati e la comunicazione sicura con i sistemi di produzione;
  • Definire l'architettura del data warehouse e la sua evoluzione, guidando le scelte tecniche e il modello dati;
  • Progettare e mantenere i processi di ingestion da fonti esterne, tra scraping e API di terze parti;
  • Definire e mantenere gli standard di affidabilità e qualità del dato, inclusa la gestione degli incidenti;
  • Monitorare e ottimizzare i costi della piattaforma dati;
  • Fare da riferimento tecnico per il team tramite code review, design doc e mentoring.

Requisiti

  • Almeno 7 anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore, di cui almeno 2 con responsabilità diretta su un data warehouse in produzione;
  • Mentalità orientata al prodotto e proattività, capacità di scegliere ed utilizzare le tecnologie più appropriate per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi del progetto, evitando soluzioni tecniche non necessarie o scelte puramente basate sulla novità tecnologica;
  • Spiccate capacità di problem solving e autonomia;
  • Capacità di definire e rispettare obiettivi e scadenze;
  • Capacità di interfacciarsi efficacemente con stakeholders non tecnici;
  • Conoscenza della piattaforma Google Cloud e nei relativi servizi dati (Google Cloud Composer, Google BigQuery, ecc.);
  • Conoscenza di SQL, in particolare dei dialetti Google BigQuery e PostgreSQL;
  • Solida esperienza di sviluppo in Python;
  • Conoscenza di Airflow;
  • Solida esperienza di data modeling per data warehouse su BigQuery;
  • Esperienza nell'ottimizzazione dei costi su BigQuery e sui servizi dati di Google Cloud;
  • Esperienza nella gestione operativa di pipeline in produzione, tra backfill, monitoraggio e gestione degli incidenti;
  • Esperienza nell'ingestion di dati da fonti esterne, tra scraping e API di terze parti;
  • Esperienza nell'integrazione di modelli LLM all'interno di pipeline dati;
  • Conoscenza delle pratiche di gestione dei dati personali e dei principi di GDPR e nLPD;
  • Esperienza con git;
  • Conoscenza di Docker e Docker Compose;
  • Esperienza con strumenti di Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Pulumi, Terraform, OpenTofu), con responsabilità su moduli e state;
  • Buona conoscenza dell'inglese tecnico, letto e scritto.

Qualifiche preferenziali

  • Esperienza con Linux e Bash;
  • Esperienza con Azure DevOps e GitHub;
  • Buona padronanza dell'inglese parlato;
  • Familiarità con le piattaforme cloud AWS e Azure;
  • Esperienza con ClickHouse;
  • Esperienza con modelli ML custom o fine tuning di LLM.

Perché lavorare in SkillSherpa

Lavorare in SkillSherpa SA significa entrare a far parte di un’azienda in forte crescita, operante in un settore dinamico e altamente innovativo.

Offriamo l’opportunità di lavorare su progetti all’avanguardia, contribuendo al progresso tecnologico insieme a un team di professionisti appassionati.

Se sei appassionato di tecnologia e desideri lavorare in un’azienda che valorizza il talento e l’innovazione, SkillSherpa è il posto giusto per te!

Range Salariale

Il range salariale lordo annuo, inclusivo di bonus, previsto per la posizione è di 75.000 CHF - 90.000 CHF.

Vantaggi

  • Contratto di lavoro full-time a tempo indeterminato, in Svizzera;
  • Bonus annuale al raggiungimento degli obiettivi definiti insieme al diretto responsabile;
  • Il venerdì si lavora mezza giornata;
  • Accesso a percorsi formativi (es. Coursera)/eventi di settore;
  • 1 giorno/settimana di remote working;
  • Contesto early-stage dove poter fare davvero la differenza.

Requisiti di candidatura

Nota importante: questa posizione è aperta solo a cittadini dell'Unione Europea e AELS, o ai possessori di regolare permesso di lavoro in Svizzera, residenti in Italia o Svizzera. La conoscenza della lingua italiana è un prerequisito fondamentale.

Non lavoriamo con agenzie.

Important note

This position is open only to citizens of the European Union and EFTA, or to holders of a valid Swiss work permit, residing in Italy or Switzerland. Knowledge of the Italian language is a fundamental prerequisite. We do not work with agencies.

title: Adjunct-Gross Anatomy Instructor

Physician Associate Program

College of Health Sciences

Alvernia University

The successful candidate will provide high-quality instruction in graduate-level human gross anatomy, integrating foundational anatomical knowledge with clinical application to prepare physician associate students for didactic and clinical education. Instruction includes classroom and laboratory teaching utilizing advanced anatomy visualization technology, including the Anatomage Table, while fostering an engaging, collaborative, and student-centered learning environment.

Essential Responsibilities

· Teach Gross Anatomy within the Physician Associate Program in accordance with the approved curriculum and course learning outcomes.

· Deliver high-quality instruction through lectures, laboratory experiences, and active learning strategies.

· Facilitate learning through the use of advanced anatomy visualization technology.

description:
Introducción

Established in 1951, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) is the leading intergovernmental organization in the field of migration and works closely with governmental, intergovernmental, and non-governmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a workplace where all employees can thrive professionally. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture on the IOM Workplace Culture webpage.

Applications are welcome from both internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those from qualified and eligible second-tier candidates during the selection process. For additional information, please refer to the internal guidance and the IOM Candidate Tier System and Internal-Equivalent Candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) and direct supervision of the Head of Programmes; and, in close coordination with the Heads of Units and the Resources Management Officer, the Senior Project Associate – (North-Eastern Region Projects, Colombia) will be responsible for the following duties:

  1. Assist in coordinating and monitoring the implementation of IOM projects in the North-Eastern region of Colombia, ensuring effective programme delivery, operational coordination, compliance with organizational procedures, and the achievement of project objectives. Serve as the focal point for programme implementation and field-level coordination within the area of responsibility.

  2. Independently lead and coordinate the implementation of the project. Monitor implementation of the activities to ensure work is proceeding according to established plans; analyse implementation difficulties and make recommendations for adjusting implementation modalities and work plans to best reflect changing environment on the field.

  3. Regularly research, follow-up, compile, analyse and present information/data on national, regional and international developments, reports, legislation and other relevant documentation, highlighting noteworthy issues for the consideration of appropriate parties.

  4. Monitor budget expenditures by verifying availability of funds and maintaining a proper record of approved project budgets and their revisions.

  5. Coordinate and monitor the financial, administrative and technical aspects of the project in line with IOM policies and donor requirements.

  6. Plan, coordinate and conduct capacity building workshops for relevant internal and external parties.

description:
Job Description

JOB TITLE: Automation Technician I

REPORTS TO: Automation Supervisor

FLSA: Non-exempt

JOB SUMMARY: This role builds and maintains automation systems to meet the needs of our internal and external customers. Responsibilities include building, troubleshooting and improving production and innovation automation systems. This role also plans and designs components and subsystems. Other responsibilities include creating training materials, mentoring and training others, supporting production processes, and solving problems as a part of multifunctional teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Replaces electrical components such as sensors, motors, etc.; fabricates cables and connectors; wires panels using schematics (backplane); mounts components using layouts (backplane); connects hardware to panel (field wiring).
  2. Properly use hand tools; properly uses measurement equipment.
  3. Marks up schematics; Documents changes to software settings in Azure.
  4. Maintains organized and standardized file structure; manages files on laptop computer and network locations; safely interacts with Windows and network locations.
  5. Navigates robot software; manipulates robots safely; updates source control properly; interprets logic flow in robot program to troubleshoot root cause.
  6. Navigates AVI software; monitors AVI performance; identifies reasons for defects; interprets logic flow in AVI program to troubleshoot root cause; understands common AVI software functions; updates source control properly.
  7. Navigates control software; monitors control input and output variables in software and on hardware; identifies machine issues using control program; updates source control properly.
  8. Completes project tasks as assigned; communicates progress to project leader.
  9. Follows safety procedures.
  10. Exhibits initiative and persistence to overcome obstacles in order to meet performance goals; Works with team well to accomplish goals.
  11. Performs other duties as required.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  1. Education/Experience. High school education coursework or GED required. Two-year technical or associate degree in automation, robotics, electronics or related field and two years relevant control systems manufacturing experience preferred. Training in computer controls for industrial processes required.
  2. Computer Skills. Ability to operate personal computer. Ability to learn software required to perform job functions (i.e. PLC, HMI, camera, AutoCAD, and Solid Works software). Experience with Microsoft Office Products required.
  3. Language Skills. Proven written and oral communication skills necessary. Ability to read, comprehend, and utilize instructions and short correspondence with professionals. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to other employees.
  4. Mathematical Skills. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratios, percent and use trigonometry. Ability to read and understand complicated designs and drawings.
  5. Reasoning Ability. Ability to solve technical issues and deal with a number of variables. Ability to follow and interpret verbal and written instructions.
  6. Other Skills and Abilities. Willingness to attend conferences or training to enhance and update knowledge and skills. Occasional travel may be requested for company business. Overtime may be required to meet work demands.
  7. Supervisory Responsibilities. Mentor and train employees learning automation techniques. Ability to direct work task to others if you are assigned the lead role in a project.
  8. Physical Demands. While performing the duties of this job, the incumbent is frequently required to sit and stand. Frequent movement throughout the facility is required. Dexterity to perform computer operations and close vision acuity necessary. May be required to move or transport up to 55 lbs.
  9. Work Environment. The duties of this job are executed in a climate-controlled environment with few temperature or humidity extremes. Noise levels will vary from very low to moderate depending on the location that the work is performed within the facility. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Employee may have contact with machining residues such as steel chips, grinding dust, EDM smoke, cutting oils and coolants. Safety glasses are required.

title: A/C Mech I (Seat)
description:
About AVMAC LLC:

AVMAC was founded by two former Naval Aviation Maintenance Officers, Bert Ortiz and Don Buzard, who collectively have more than eight decades of experience assigned to, or directly supporting, both carrier and amphibious aviation.

AVMAC’s corporate staff and leadership team employ many with similar backgrounds and experience, which makes it a highly knowledgeable force multiplier to their customer base. The company prides itself on hiring, recruiting and training veterans as it continues to serve the Department of Defense and the Department of Transportation Homeland Security and commercial customers nationwide.

Position Summary: AVMAC LLC is seeking a qualified and experienced F/A-18 Egress/Environmental Control System (ECS) Mechanic who performs scheduled and unscheduled Organizational-Level (O-Level) maintenance on Marine Corps Legacy F/A-18 aircraft egress systems and environmental control systems in accordance with the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP), applicable Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) technical manuals, Maintenance Requirement Cards (MRCs), and established maintenance procedures. The mechanic ensures all maintenance is completed safely, accurately, and in compliance with USN/USMC and company quality standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled Organizational-Level (O-Level) maintenance on Legacy F/A-18 egress and Environmental Control Systems (ECS) in accordance with NAMP and applicable maintenance manuals.
  • Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain ejection seats, canopy systems, and associated egress components to ensure safe aircraft operation.
  • Maintain and service ECS components, including air conditioning, pressurization, and environmental regulation systems.
  • Execute maintenance procedures using F/A-18C/D Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals (IETMs) with minimal supervision.
  • Diagnose system discrepancies and implement corrective actions to restore aircraft to mission-capable status.
  • Accurately document maintenance actions, discrepancies, and corrective measures in NALCOMIS OOMA.
  • Apply technical directives, maintenance instructions, and safety procedures relevant to Legacy F/A-18 systems.
  • Conduct functional checks, operational tests, and inspections to verify system performance and compliance.
  • Support flight line operations while strictly adhering to all safety, security, and quality assurance standards.
  • Maintain readiness of assigned aircraft to meet mission requirements.

Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills Required:

  • Minimum of 2 years aviation maintenance experience with a minimum of 2 years of verifiable F/A-18 experience.
  • Completion of the F/A-18 ECS System "C" School.
  • Must show proof of maintenance and repair experience on Naval/USMC F/A-18 aircraft.
  • Must possess the ability to work independently, without technical guidance, to perform all tasks outlined in the F/A-18 Interactive Electronic Maintenance Manual (IETM).
  • Must be familiar with all publications relevant to the maintenance of the F/A-18 and have a thorough practical and theoretical knowledge of the aircraft equipment/systems.
  • Must possess an understanding of the NALCOMIS OOMA maintenance documentation program.
  • Must be able to acquire and maintain a secret clearance.
  • Must have and be able to maintain all explosive handling/safety qualifications as outlined in applicable publications.

Physical and Environmental Requirements:

  • Work may require frequent bending, reaching and climbing.
  • May frequently lift and carry items weighing up to fifty pounds and occasionally lift heavier items with the assistance of other workers.
  • Work may be performed on top or under equipment in cramped or awkward positions.
  • Must be able to sit, stand, squat, walk, and talk for extended periods during shift.
  • Must have the mobility to climb stairs and ladders.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain base access.

What We Offer: (benefits vary based on FT, PT, or On-Call status)

  • Benefits offered include Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Employer-paid Life insurance, long-term disability and short-term disability
  • Paid time off -including 11 Holidays (8 hours per holiday)
  • Participation in the AVMAC LLC 401(k) plan

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

AVMAC is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a diverse workplace and affirm equal opportunity for all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable law, including affirmative action for qualified individuals with disabilities and veterans.

title: Prepress Quality Control Technician
description:
SUMMARY Overview of the position

Responsible for reviewing digital files, proofs, and overlays to ensure content is built to required specifications and precise to established internal expectations, documented tolerances, print industry standards, procedures and/or published direction. Evaluate and review cards, provide direction for print accuracy or improvement. Quality Control is an extension of Prepress Production and works closely with a variety of internal departments to ensure quality and fiscal responsibility.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The following statements are intended to describe the general nature of the level of work being performed by an individual assigned to this job. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Review print design engineering, product content, printability and make recommendations to ensure quality standards are attained.
  • Assessed delivered information and implementation of direction received from designated Lead, Project Manager(s), Marketing, Legal, Design, Sports & Entertainment, Operations and written documentation from mechanicals, briefs, and costing documentation.
  • Ensure the highest possible quality of files produced within lithographic pre-production environment. Quality Control Technician(s) will maintain a global view of these production procedures and make on-going recommendations to ensure tolerances are maintained and quality product files produced.
  • Effective communication skills required demonstrate close mindfulness with organized practices. Responsible for interacting daily with Digital Operations Team Lead, Project Manager(s), Prepress Production personnel and Designers.’
  • Support and adhere to internal Creative Departmental procedures and requirements to include but not limited to, assisting Prepress Production during production heavy cycles.
  • Proficiency in the following software or systems: Adobe Creative Suite, MS Office, and Excel.
  • Hands-on, energetic and motivated self-starter with the ability to work additional hours as required.

INTERACTION

This position will interact closely with the Director of Creative, Digital Operations Production Manager, Project Managers, Prepress Production, Designers, and other internal personnel.

EDUCATION/YEARS EXPERIENCE

  • High School Diploma or equivalent. College Degree with an emphasis in Graphic Arts a plus.
  • 1-2 years of experience in Prepress or related area, publishing, or relevant duties.
  • Knowledge of Kodak Prinergy is a plus.

REQUIREMENTS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Present understanding of Prepress and Print Industries’ standards, competent knowledge of established production tolerances. Familiarity with the 4/c process, to include, but not limited to: spot colors, varnish, foil, die cuts, deboss and/or embossing. Imposition software skills with a basic understanding of file standards for print production (bleed, trapping, color separation, resolution, etc.).

The qualified applicant must possess acceptable computer skills; a working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite is a plus. Additionally, basic to intermediate proficiency in the following software: Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills demonstrate close mindfulness with organized practices. Ability to articulate clearly with internal partners and not be afraid to ask questions.
  • Effective organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple, high priority projects with dedicated attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, comprehend written instructions and follow pre-established guidelines.
  • Utilize technology and maximize efficiency: Maintain education and ability of innovative techniques, technologies, and software capabilities. On an on-going basis, ensure we are maximizing our technology resources and making recommendations for improvements.
  • Excellent interpersonal, problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Professional demeanor; collaborator orientation.
  • Ability to perform duties under minimal supervision while exercising reasonable discretion and independent judgment.
  • Manage time effectively, prioritizing duties and meeting deadlines. Ability to maintain flexible work hours. Work hours are mostly consistent, but production requirements require flexibility.

title: Resident Assistant
description:
II. Job Summary:

The purpose of this position is to provide direct and daily care to all residents, including residents of the Home Care Services (HCS) program. This position requires maintaining professional boundaries with residents who live with physical illness, mental illness, and chemical addiction.

The Resident Assistant will authentically implement harm reduction and housing first strategies with residents, de-escalate chaotic situations and effectively redirect residents, and communicate effectively and respectfully with residents who may exhibit behaviors associated with chemical use and various mental health symptoms. Various shifts available, both full and part time, Monday through Friday and may also include weekends and on-call duty. The ideal candidate will have the ability to pick up open shifts on days, evenings, and overnight. Starting rate of pay is $15.00 per hour.


This is a part time position, pay $18.50-$20.50 with shift differentials for overnights, weekends, Holidays and last minute shifts. Benefits include 4% 403B match, dental, vision and limited free telehealth for medical and counseling.

III. Core Job Functions:

General Duties and Responsibilities:

  • To provide direct care and supports to all residents.
  • Communicate with relevant staff members—both verbally and electronically—all pertinent information regarding residents’ mental, physical, emotional, and chemical health.
  • Manage the front desk independently, monitor security cameras, register all visitors, and maintain building safety and security.
  • Attend regular staff meetings and trainings as assigned by Supportive Services Manager.
  • Complete other tasks as assigned by Supportive Services Manager.

Home Care Services Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Correctly and safely dispense medications (liquids, tablets, capsules, eye drops, ear drops, inhalers, etc.) to residents in the Home Care Service (HCS) program.
  • Provide housekeeping, laundry, and meal preparation to residents in the HCS program as needed.
  • Provide assistance with bathing, grooming and other personal cares and/or delegated tasks under the direction of Nursing to residents in the HCS as needed.
  • Correctly and safely operate medical devices and equipment as needed (i.e., blood pressure cuff).
  • Communicate with Nursing and other Resident Assistants to make sure that medication administration and home care tasks for HCS residents are completed in a timely manner during each shift, and document those tasks appropriately in the electronic charting software.
  • Recognize when it is appropriate to contact the on-call nurse for support to ensure safety of residents in the HCS program.
  • Meet with nursing staff every 30 days after initial hire and every 90 days thereafter for assessment/observation of delegated nursing tasks.

IV. Position Requirements:

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • One year in the health or social service fields preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to read, write and speak English sufficiently to communicate pertinent medical and social services to residents and to communicate with management and staff.
  • Willingness to work in an environment guided by housing first and harm reduction principles.
  • Strong knowledge of emergency procedures and ability to stay calm in stressful situations.
  • Must be able to maintain a professional manner when working with residents, staff, and volunteers.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise good judgment.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Highly organized and ability to multi-task.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality in both client and employee information.
  • Ability to efficiently utilize electronic charting software.
  • Ability to work within an interdisciplinary team.
  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries and practice self-care in a position that works with residents struggling with physical, mental, and chemical health issues.
  • Ability to take and pass the required Medications Administration Training.
  • Ability to perform physical jobs such as doing laundry, cooking, and cleaning in a home setting.
  • Cognitive ability to coordinate the administration of all medications/controlled substances correctly and safely for all residents of the HCS program.
  • Sufficient physical strength to safely lift/transfer residents without causing injury to self or residents.
  • Knowledge and manual dexterity to operate medical equipment safely.
  • Must have the emotional stability needed to cope with the stress of the position.
  • Have a sensitivity and aptitude for working with individuals who are living with HIV/AIDS, were formally homeless and have a trauma background.
  • Ability to work respectfully and communicate effectively with multi-cultural, diverse populations.

Licenses and/or Certifications:

  • CPR/First Aid Certification required; training provided to obtain certification.
  • Driver’s License, State ID, or Passport

V. Working Conditions and Environment:

This position is in a supportive housing building for adults living with HIV/AIDS and other disabilities. Many of the residents are formerly homeless individuals. The building is accessible and smoke free. This position staffs the building 24 hours a day, seven days a week, 365 days per year.

The position includes doing laundry, housekeeping, cooking, lifting/transferring residents, and other physical tasks. This position requires the manual dexterity to use various types of medical equipment, as well as the cognitive ability to perform more detailed tasks such as medication administration, charting, filing, and copying. The person in this position will be exposed to body fluids, infections, odors.

All employees are expected to work effectively in a mission-driven organization whose residents and staff exhibit significant diversity with respect to age, race/color, disability, marital status, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, familial status, genetic information, or veteran’s status.

Note: Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

title: Campus Organizer, Philadelphia
description:
Project 26 Pennsylvania (P26 PA) is the home for Pennsylvania students who are ready to challenge the far-right's attacks on our futures and build a Pennsylvania where Gen Z can lead and thrive.

In 2025 alone, Trump has signed over 200 Executive Orders that have directly impacted millions of Americans and led to:

  • The loss of basic human rights and the separation of families due to unjust ICE raids
  • A massive increase in the wealth of the top 1% at the expense of basic healthcare and unbiased public media funding
  • An economy where tariffs and inflation is so high millions of people are working multiple jobs and still can’t pay their bills
  • Widespread feelings of hopelessness and outrage amongst young voters

The outcome of Pennsylvania’s 2026 elections will determine the balance of power in the House which will influence the make-up of Congress, as some of the most competitive congressional races will happen in our backyard. Which will allow us to create a congress that can hold the President accountable to representing the people, not billionaires.

In 2026, young Pennsylvanians will have the opportunity to elect a Governor, who will be instrumental in standing up to a government that has constantly overlooked the youth. At an estimated 793,555 registered voters across the state, Gen-Z has the power to determine the outcomes of these elections–but only if we get organized now.

Since 2023, P26 has built a team of strong youth advocates for Gen-Z, and has worked to create a community for us in politics, through peer-to-peer outreach, —and we’re building a scrappy and innovative team that will organize and inspire thousands of PA youth to vote in both the Primary and General Elections in 2026.

What Will You Do?

This is not a conventional organizing position. Instead of spending time in a field office making calls, a typical day will require being on campus or in the community in person talking to young people, managing teams of fellows and volunteers, and fostering relationships with campus and community networks for long-term collaboration. You will be asked to get goofy, creative, and gritty-as-hell to build a startup that empowers young people for many elections to come.

Responsibilities Include:

Youth Programming (30%)

  • Develop and execute a youth program that engages students and turns out young voters.
  • Conduct direct voter contact and list-building through dorm-storming, high-traffic canvassing, relational organizing, and more.
  • Plan and run engaging, student-centered events.
  • Identify and address barriers to student civic engagement and voter turnout.

Hiring, Training, & Managing Teams (30%)

  • Recruit, hire, and manage a team of paid fellows and volunteers to mobilize their peers.
  • Conduct training sessions to set goals, assign responsibilities, and turn enthusiasm into action.

Data Management & Entry (20%)

  • Ensure accurate collection and quality control of voter registration forms.
  • Manage daily data entry into systems such as America Votes and BLOCKS.

Build Relationships and Coalitions (20%)

  • Build relationships with student or youth leaders and organizations to collaboratively expand organizing reach.

Who Are You?

You’re a strong fit if you:

  • Thrive in fast-changing environments and know how to stay focused even when circumstances feel uncertain.
  • Are excited and eager to talk with lots of students (and are especially comfortable cold-approaching strangers).
  • Are creative and scrappy, with the instinct to problem-solve in real time.
  • Have a passion for empowering young people to get involved in the political process.
  • Are a self-starter who is highly organized, manages time well, and can juggle multiple priorities without losing momentum.
  • Can work weekends and irregular hours as required.
  • Have a driver's license and access to a reliable car.
  • Live near (or are willing to relocate to) one of our focus campuses.

Previous experience organizing for an electoral campaign is a plus; previous experience with campus organizing is a bigger plus. Neither are required.

We will be hiring for this position in multiple cohorts. Students who will be graduating over the Spring and Summer of '26 are strongly encouraged to apply now!

Position Details

  • Campus Organizers will report directly to the Organizing Directors.
  • Candidates must live in or be willing to relocate to Philadelphia.
  • Compensation & Hours: Compensation for this role is $25.00 per hour, and includes PTO, health benefits, and a technology stipend. This is a full-time role.
    • There may be points throughout the year where organizers are asked to work additional hours and/or weekends.
  • Blackout Periods: During key mobilization periods, staff will observe PTO blackout dates. Barring parental, bereavement, or another protected leave class, staff will not be able to take PTO during these times.
    • The month of August
    • 10 days before a Voter Registration Deadline
    • 10 days before a General or Primary election
  • To Apply: Please submit this short application. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis with a projected hiring date of June 1, 2026.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage Black, indigenous, people of color, women, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, and others who identify with underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Parts Consultant
description:
Job Description: Parts Consultant

We are looking for a motivated individual to join our growing team at Campbell Supply Company, where our goal is to drive success by providing exceptional service, quality products, and tailored solutions for the commercial and emergency vehicle industries. We are a second-generation family-owned dealership with 7 locations and have proudly served our customers since 1967.

Position Overview:

Campbell Supply Company is seeking a Parts Consultant to join our team. This versatile role may include responsibilities in the parts counter, back counter, or phone room, depending on company needs and the candidate's strengths. As a Parts Consultant, you will assist customers in identifying and purchasing the right parts for their needs while contributing to sales growth and increased gross margins. Your performance will be evaluated using a competency scale (A, B, or C), which will influence your bonus percentage.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Assistance: Provide exceptional service at the parts counter, back counter, or phone room by helping customers find the right parts for their specific applications. Offer guidance, product insights, and technical knowledge to ensure satisfaction.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date expertise on the company's full product line, including compatibility and benefits. Stay informed on industry developments, trends, and innovations.
  • Sales Generation: Actively engage with walk-in and phone-in customers to promote and upsell parts and accessories. Use effective sales techniques to meet or exceed personal and team goals.
  • Order Processing: Accurately process orders across multiple channels, ensuring parts are correctly selected and delivered or prepared for pickup in a timely manner.
  • Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and communicate needs with the inventory team. Recommend reorders or new product additions based on demand and customer feedback.
  • Relationship Building: Develop strong connections with customers, including repair technicians, contractors, and fleet operators. Attend industry events and training to broaden your network and knowledge base.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Track personal and team sales data, including gross margins. Prepare performance reports and offer suggestions to improve sales and efficiency.
  • Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training to stay current with product updates and sales strategies. Support onboarding and development of new team members by sharing knowledge and best practices.

Competency Evaluation and Compensation:

Performance will be assessed on a scale of A, B, or C, based on factors such as product expertise, service quality, and sales results. Your competency level will directly influence the bonus rate you earn.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (technical or vocational training is a plus)
  • Previous experience in sales or customer service, preferably in the automotive, equipment, or heavy-duty industry
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Technical knowledge of vehicle or machinery parts is highly desirable
  • Goal-oriented with a drive to succeed in a sales environment
  • Skilled in problem-solving and decision-making
  • Comfortable using inventory management and point-of-sale software

Benefits at Campbell Supply Company:

We believe in supporting our employees in and out of the workplace. Our benefits include:

  • Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your family
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Generous PTO to help maintain work-life balance
  • Employee Discount Portal: Access to special deals and savings through our Lifemart partnership
  • Education Reimbursement: Financial support for courses and certifications that help you grow professionally

Campbell Supply Company is committed to fostering a positive, inclusive work environment where you can thrive personally and professionally. If you're passionate about parts, people, and performance, we want to hear from you!

Note: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. Specific responsibilities and requirements may vary based on company needs.

Campbell Supply Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Description

JOB TITLE: Project Manager

REPORTS TO: Director of Engineering

FLSA: Exempt

Summary of Responsibilities:

The Project Manager leads, motivates and develops objectives for new tooling and automation projects through qualification for customer project functions. This role ensures production objectives are met in the areas of quality, scheduling, budget and customer satisfaction. Primary point of contact for assigned projects. Provides daily information to customers and sales staff on the status of assigned projects. Prepare reports for management showing progress and performance of projects.

Working Relationships:

The Project Manager reports to the Director of Engineering. This role collaborates with the customer, internal sales team, project engineering team, quality engineering team and all other support areas to ensure accomplishment of new tooling and automation project through qualification.

Specific Responsibilities:

  • Coordinates progress and planning with Engineering, Sales, Production and Quality Departments to achieve on time tooling, unqualified part orders and qualifications to customers.
  • Prepares and delivers comprehensive and understandable project status reports to management and leadership.
  • Proactively identify project risks and implement contingency plans when issues arise.
  • Ensure problems or obstacles are resolved quickly to minimize impacts to timeline.
  • Coordinate with specific areas of production, ensuring objectives for quality, scheduling, budget and customer satisfaction are achieved.
  • Develop partner relationships with customers.
  • Responsible for the creation of project proposals that establish technical requirements.
  • Lead Accumold’s development of new technical advances working with customers and the Accumold team.
  • Responsible for establishing and maintaining team standards, practices and procedures in accordance with company policy.
  • Performs duties in accordance with Accumold’s Core Values, Policies, and Objectives. This includes the Quality Policy and Environmental Policy. Other duties as required.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  1. Education/Experience. Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business preferred or suitable combination of education and experience of its equal. Experience working within the plastics molding industry preferred with a strong background in any or all of the following: plastic injection molding, mold building or mold design.
  2. Computer Skills. Ability to operate personal computer. Knowledge of Windows based programs such as Outlook, Excel, Access, MS Project, Word, AutoCAD and Solid Works.
  3. Language Skills. Read, comprehend, and utilize instructions and correspondence with professionals. Effectively present directions and information in one-on-one and small group situation to other employees.
  4. Mathematical Skills. Able to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Knowledge of rate, ratios, percent and use trigonometry. Ability to read and understand complicated designs and drawings.
  5. Reasoning Ability. Knowledge to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Use experience to understand cause and effect as it relates to mold making to trouble shoot and problem solve.
  6. Other Skills and Abilities. Ability to work with various personnel in departments to reach consensus on work related issues. Must be able to maintain confidentiality and a professional relationship with fellow workers and the general public. Willingness to attend conferences, classes or training to enhance and update knowledge and skills. Occasional travel may be requested for company business.
  7. Supervisory Responsibilities. Direct work task to others to complete project.
  8. Physical Demands. While performing the duties of this job, the incumbent is required to stand and use hand to manipulate very small parts or tweezers. Sense of touch may be used to detect texture, burs and edges. Frequent movement throughout the facility is required. Normal or corrected to normal vision is required with good color vision, close vision, and ability to use microscope and adjust focus. May be required to occasionally move or transport up to 55 lbs.
  9. Work Environment. The duties of this job are executed in a climate-controlled environment with few temperature or humidity extremes. Noise levels will vary from very low in the office area to moderate within the manufacturing facility. Employee may have contact with machining residues such as steel chips, grinding dust, EDM smoke, cutting oils and coolants. Safety glasses are required in manufacturing areas.

The description given is intended only to provide information about the general nature of the job and is not an all-inclusive list of the job duties, skills or abilities.

Employment with Accumold is “at will”, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate employment at any time and for any or no reason.

title: Application Architect
description:
Application Architect

Job Code: EAA-26 | Department: Information Technology |Employment Type: Full-time

Role Purpose

Define, govern and evolve the enterprise application architecture to ensure applications, integrations, data exchanges and technology choices support GTA business capabilities, digital strategy and target architecture. The role provides architecture direction for application modernisation, solution design and portfolio rationalisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the application portfolio, application architecture views, reference architectures and lifecycle roadmaps.
  • Assess application fit, health, technical debt, duplication, integration dependencies and alignment to business capabilities.
  • Define target-state application architecture, application rationalisation recommendations and transition roadmaps.
  • Review solution designs, architecture documents and non-functional requirements for compliance with EA principles and standards.
  • Work with solution, data, infrastructure, security and integration teams to ensure coherent end-to-end designs.
  • Establish traceability between business capabilities, processes, applications, data entities, interfaces and technology components.
  • Support application modernisation, cloud adoption, package selection and migration initiatives with architecture guidance.
  • Contribute to architecture governance, design reviews, exceptions management, standards and EA repository quality.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

Experience

At least 5 years of relevant experience in application architecture, solution architecture, systems analysis/design, application portfolio management, or a closely related role.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

Certification

TOGAF certification is required or strongly preferred. ArchiMate, cloud architecture, integration, ITIL, or relevant platform certifications are advantageous.

Technical Background

Experience with enterprise applications, APIs/integrations, application lifecycle management and modernisation is required.

Language

Arabic (Good To have)

Very good Business English

Required Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of application architecture patterns, API-led integration, service-oriented design and application lifecycle management.
  • Practical knowledge of TOGAF and ArchiMate application-layer modelling; ability to create actionable architecture views.
  • Experience assessing application portfolios, technical debt, application health, fit-for-purpose and rationalisation opportunities.
  • Familiarity with cloud, security, data and integration considerations in enterprise solution design.
  • Strong stakeholder-management, analytical, documentation and design-review skills.

Key Deliverables

  • Application portfolio and lifecycle/health assessment
  • Current- and target-state application architecture views
  • Application reference architectures, standards and design principles
  • Application rationalisation and modernisation roadmap
  • Application-to-capability, data and integration traceability

Context:

IOM has undertaken a Business Transformation (BT) process, a priority driven by IOM's Internal Governance Framework (IGF) initiative including a global review of its planning, budgeting, financial, project resources management andreporting requirements and enterprise resource planning management (ERP)-based process flows to update its systems and establish a fit-for-future way of working globally, supported by Oracle Cloud Fusion ERP, Oracle Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and other custom systems and related satellite technologies. The resulting enterprise solution is known internally as Wave.

Under the direct supervision of the Chief, Corporate Solutions Unit (CSU), and in functional coordination with the relevant Business Process Owners (BPOs) and other Wave ERP BRMs, the Oracle Financial Functional Stream Lead (Finance to Manage) will be responsible for ensuring that the enterprise resource planning management (ERP) solution continues to meet organizational performance objectives, remain aligned with evolving organizational requirements, and remains technically sound with respect to continuous platform updates and continuous business improvement.

  1. Lead and act as F2M focal point for the BRM Team with regards to manage and enhance IOM’s system-based finance process and procedures. (cost objects, commitment tracking, financial monitoring, account payable, payments processing and settlement, reporting).
  2. Serve and collaborate with the Department of Finance and Administrative Management (DFAM) and the global F2M community to understand the broad financial management context, address user needs, and solve issues proactively.
  3. Set the priorities and manage the outputs contracted resources (vendor and internal teams) to ensure requirements/problems are understood and are being addressed in a correct and timely fashion.
  4. Ensure continuity of operations of F2M-related systems, monitor software upgrades including regression testing, technical integrations, management of the cloud platforms and related users and any other task eventually performed by selected vendors.
  5. Monitor and analyze end-user support requests and Tier 3 (application change requests and defect resolution) to achieve end-user satisfaction and the operational requirements of the F2M process coverage.
  6. Lead business relationships with business process owners and other stakeholders covering the F2M scope (including cross-functional integrations) to define demands for solution, measure and report quality of services and coordinate issues resolution.
  7. Manage the full change process lifecycle including performing business analyses and identifying, advising and coordinating on business process improvement and management of change activities, ensuring cross-functional integration and compatibility, impacting business functions resulting from solution enhancements and changes with a specific focus on maximizing the evolution allowed by the periodic release of new functions by the cloud providers.
  8. Liaise with the Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Enterprise Architect to ensure CSU's solutions for F2M domains remain compatible with and help advance ICT's overall architectural and technology goals.
  9. Prepare and maintain technical and user documentation for F2M domains applications, detailed technical presentations and various technical reports.
  10. Manage all related tasks and operations activities and track, monitor and report on progress against plans, requirements, quality measures and operational service levels vs. agreements.
  11. Manage change to promote acceptance and ''buy-in' at all stages and ensure smooth implementation of necessary changes to internal business practices, procedures, processes and systems.
  12. Provide direct oversight and support to external expert, consultants, vendors and suppliers engaged by the CSU in the context of delivering the in-scope solutions and supporting elements.

  13. Perform such other duties as may be assigned.

Education

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Information Technology or a related field from an accredited academic institution with seven years of relevant professional experience; or,
  • University degree in the above fields with nine years of relevant professional experience.
  • Professional certification as qualified accountant (ACCA, CA, CPA, CIMA, CIPFA) is an advantage.

Experience

  • Extensive experience in accounting and financial management, including but not limited to accounts consolidation, financial analysis, accounting processes and procedures design, master data structure management, and general financial reporting, in a large-scale organization;
  • Experience in practical implementation of effective financial controls;
  • Extensive experience with ERP software/systems and accounting-related technological solutions; and,
  • Direct experience in an active role in an ERP implementation and accounting structures set-up is a distinct advantage.

Skills

  • Practical knowledge of IPSAS accounting standards a distinct advantage;
  • Proven expertise in Oracle Cloud Fusion ERP (certification an advantage) software/systems for finance, planning, budgeting, project resources management and reporting technological solutions in terms of configuration and accounting rules/verifications management;
  • Sound and Proven communication skills, ability to present information in a comprehensive, clear and concise manner both in writing and verbally;
  • Demonstrate ability to conduct analyses, excellent writing skills accompanied with the ability to edit a range of different materials, including but not limited to supply chain policies, related instructions, guidelines and reports for different audiences; and,
  • Knowledge of Oracle Cloud Fusion ERP modules and their configuration and operation.

title: Count Team Attendant
description:
Position Summary:

Count Team Attendant responsibilities include acting in accordance with all Company standards, policies, and procedures. Primary responsibilities include being part of a team that removes bills from validators from slot machines (the drop) and counts funds from table games and slots and poker, sportsbook, keno, and kiosk (the count). Ensures compliance and integrity of the drop and count from gaming operations pursuant to the System of Internal Control Standards

About Us:

At Gun Lake Casino Resort, every Team Member is an ambassador, essential to the success of our company and our culture. We expect that all Team Members take personal ownership in ensuring that everything they do is in the best interest of Gun Lake Casino Resort and embody the core values of the Seven Grandfather Teachings:

Love: Love your brothers and sisters and share with them.

Truth: Be true in everything you do. Be true to yourself and to your fellow Humans.

Respect: You must give respect if you expect respect. Respect everyone, all persons, and all the things created.

Bravery: To do what is right, even in the most difficult of times.

Honesty: Be honest in every action and provide good feelings in your heart.

Wisdom: We cherish knowledge; wisdom is used for the good of the people.

Humility: Know that you are equal to everyone else, no better, no less.

In this Role:

  • Responsible for practicing, supporting, and promoting Gun Lake Casino Resort’s “Unsurpassed Service Standards” at all times.
  • Protects company assets.
  • Complies with Gun Lake Casino Resort’s System of Internal Controls (SICS) and policies and procedures and contributes to the integrity of the drop and count.
  • Performs daily scheduled drop of bill validators from slot machines.
  • Opens slot bill validators, and sorts and counts the currency inside the validators using the currency counting machines.
  • Sorts, verifies, and bundles currency according to denomination.
  • Ensures slot count is complete, accurate, and properly documented.
  • Opens Table Games pit boxes, sorts and counts the currency inside the box using the currency counting machines. Sorts and counts Table Games paperwork for fills, credits, and coupons by box and shift.
  • Input totals for all activity by box and shift into the computer.
  • Ensures Table Games count is complete, accurate, and properly documented.
  • Remits all tallied currency to the Cage and the necessary reports to Accounting.
  • Maintains the general cleanliness of the count room at all times.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Opens Poker cans, sorts and verifies contents.
  • Fills and processes Kiosks – including BV’s and cash cassettes.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Must be 21+ years of age.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively with little supervision or as a team.
  • Ability to maintain effective relationships.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy are required.
  • Be able to perform math calculations without the use of a calculator.
  • Computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office preferred.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a gaming license from Gun Lake Tribal Gaming Authority.


Physical Requirements:

  • Requires normal, corrective vision range, the ability to see color, and the ability to distinguish letters, numbers, and symbols.
  • Ability to continuously lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand for the duration of the shift.
  • Manual dexterity to perform job-related functions.


Work Conditions:

Work is typically in an area which may be unusually hot, cold, and/or noisy and may contain second-hand smoke. Work may be performed in small areas with a 3ft. wide access. Tasks performed from a sitting or non-sitting position. Team Members will be required to stand, walk, lift, reach, push, pull, and grasp. These tasks include the maintenance and care of assigned areas. Work may entail trained chemical usage. Constant contact with fellow Team Members and Guests.

Disclaimer and Conditions of Employment:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by persons assigned to this job. These statements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.

All applicants must be able to demonstrate their US work authorization during the employment verification process. The pre-employment process also requires the ability to pass a criminal background investigation, and drug test.

The Match-E-Be-Nash-She-Wish Band of Pottawatomi Indians abides by Native American preference in its hiring and employment policies.

title: Packaging Associate
description:
City Brewing Company – Who We Are

With our roots in La Crosse, WI, we are proud to be North America’s largest co-packager of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages with four locations across the United States. By prioritizing safety and quality for our team, customers and partners, we put Safety and Quality First. We value Customer Focus by treating our customers’ needs as our own and deliver on our commitments together. We promote a culture of One Team by valuing and supporting each other to create shared success. We Take Pride in our work and the products we produce. We believe Clear Communication is essential for effective teamwork.

Job Summary

City Brewery in La Crosse, WI, has immediate opportunities for a Packaging Operator in our packaging department. The Packaging Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining packaging machinery to ensure the accurate and efficient packaging of products according to company standards and production schedules. This role involves monitoring equipment, performing quality checks, troubleshooting basic issues, and adhering to safety and sanitation protocols. The Packaging Operator works closely with team members and supervisors to maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while meeting daily production goals. Attention to detail, consistency, and the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing setting are key to success in this position.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Operate packaging machinery and equipment safely and efficiently.
  • Monitor the packaging line for consistent product flow and quality output.
  • Inspect packaged products to ensure they meet quality and labeling standards.
  • Set up machines for daily production runs and perform basic troubleshooting.
  • Load packaging materials (film, boxes, label) into machines as needed.
  • Record production data, including quantities, downtime and machine settings.
  • Communicate with maintenance and supervisory staff regarding equipment issues.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the work area in compliance with GMP and safety standards.
  • Follow standard operating procedures, PPE requirements and company policies at all times.
  • Support team members and assist in training new operators as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a food or beverage manufacturing environment preferred.
  • High school diploma, GED, HSED or relevant work experience required.
  • Must be 18 years old.

title: Engineering Director, Geo Imagery
location: Mountain View, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA
description:
As the Engineering Director for the Geo Imagery organization, you will own the end-to-end platform that captures, processes, publishes, and serves geospatial imagery from Street View cars to satellites, as well as the core perception systems that help Google Maps "understand" what it sees and present immersive 3D photoreal experiences to billions of users.

In this role, you will manage a highly specialized engineering organization of full-time employees, spanning perception, hardware, exa-scale data processing and serving, and photoreal 3D modeling. You will partner tightly in a "four-in-a-box" model with product managers, technical program managers, and operations leads to ensure that Geo's visual assets are continuously refreshed and optimized to power immersive user experiences, B2B enterprise services, and Google's broader Gemini AI training needs. Furthermore, you will serve as a crucial site leader for our Boulder (BLD) and Mountain View (MTV) teams, driving innovation in areas like photoreal 3D products, sensor hardware systems, global sensor acquisition, and generative AI world understanding.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Own the ML and computer vision technologies that process car, airplane, and satellite-based sensors, cameras, and vehicle-provided telemetry to automatically identify real-world features (e.g., stop signs, lane markings, and building entrances). Improve Google Maps’ freshness and detail by shifting to purer AI model-based inference and real-time world-modeling.
  • Direct innovation for both the hardware and software for Google's imagery acquisition engines, including Street View vehicles, drones, and aerial survey planes. Evaluate "build-vs-buy" opportunities and external partnerships to maintain excellent coverage and freshness, and enable strategically differentiating Google Maps products and features.
  • Lead the data pipelines that ingest, process, and publish exa-scale sensor data, and serve it to users and customers worldwide in Google Maps, Earth, and Google Maps Platform.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a similar degree/field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience in software engineering leadership roles, with experience building products or platforms.
  • Experience in Machine Learning/Computer Vision, real-time data pipelines, 3D graphics/reconstruction, or hardware/sensor platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Skilled communicator with the ability to align senior executive stakeholders and operate smoothly in a tight "four-in-a-box" structure with product management, technical program Management, and operations partners.
  • Commitment to fostering a healthy organizational culture, mitigating technical resource scarcity, and coaching senior managers for multiplicative impact.

title: Määräaikainen myyjä (10h) - Turku Länsikeskus, Turku Tampereentie
description:
Haemme nyt osaavaan ja energiseen tiimimme Turku Länsikeskus, Turku Tampereentie myymäläryhmään uutta työkaveria!

Tehtävä: Myyjä

Työsuhde: Määräaikainen ajalle 19.10.2026-12.4.2027

Työtunnit/vko: 10h

Sijainti: Turku

Palkkaus: vaativuustaso 2 (11,98-14,03 €/h)

Haluaisitko olla juuri se henkilö, joka tekee asiakkaan päivästä hitusen paremman? Meidät Alkolaiset tunnetaan maailmanluokan asiakaspalvelusta ja yhteisöllisyydestä, ja nyt etsimme tiimiimme uutta energistä myyjää. Tässä tehtävässä olet keskeisessä roolissa tuottamassa asiakkaillemme unohtumattoman palvelukokemuksen.

Meillä yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen. Myymälään saapuvan asiakkaamme palveleminen on tärkein tehtävämme, ja tämän lisäksi työpäiviisi voi kuulua myymälän ylläpitotehtäviä kuten tuotteiden hyllyttämistä, kassatyötä, myymälän siivousta, kuorman purkua ja verkkokauppatilausten luovuttamista. Meillä on välittävä ja yhteisöllinen ilmapiiri, toimimme yhdessä ja autamme toisiamme.

Tarjoamme sinulle keskimäärin 10/työtuntia viikossa, ja halutessasi voit tehdä lisätyötä myös muissa lähialueen myymälöissä tutustuen uusiin työkavereihisi.

Millaisia henkilökohtaisia ominaisuuksia arvostamme uudessa työkaverissamme?

  • Halua ylittää asiakkaan odotukset: Meille tärkeintä on aito halu työskennellä asiakaspalvelun ja tuotteidemme parissa. Haussa katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemuksen asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityöstä etenkin erikoiskaupan alalla, sekä tuotepuolemme tuntemuksen esimerkiksi ravintola-alan työkokemuksen tai harrastuneisuuden kautta.
  • Innostusta ja asennetta: Olet innokas oppimaan uutta ja kehittämään itseäsi. Pidät aidosti ihmisten kohtaamisista, olet sosiaalisesti rohkea ja haluat tarjota kanssamme asiakkaillemme unohtumattoman palvelukokemuksen.
  • Valmiutta joustavuuteen: Toivomme että sinulla on valmius työskennellä joustavasti aukiolojen puitteissa, myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.
  • Olet loistava tiimipelaaja, jonka kanssa yhteistyö on sujuvaa hyvien vuorovaikutustaitojesi ansiosta. Luot ympärillesi positiivista energiaa ja olet hyvä tyyppi, jonka kanssa on kiva tehdä töitä! Tiimityötaitojen lisäksi toivomme, että sinulta löytyy valmiutta myös yksintyöskentelyyn tarvittaessa.
  • 18 vuoden ikää ja arvomaailman kohtaamista: Olet täysi-ikäinen ja jaat Alkon vastuullisuusarvot.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Palkkaus: Tehtävän vaativuustason mukainen palkkaus, vaativuustaso 2 (11,98-14,03 €/h). Palkan tarkempi määrä määritetään tehtävään valitessa perustuen henkilön kokemukseen sekä käytettävyyteen.
  • Jatkuva osaamisen kehittäminen: Työskentelemällä meillä tulet oppimaan laadukkaiden koulutustemme kautta ruoan ja juoman yhdistämisestä sekä miten tuottaa asiakkaallemme unohtumaton palvelukokemus joka ylittää odotukset.
  • Monipuoliset henkilöstöedut: Saat mm. kattavan työterveyden, mahdollisuuden hyödyntää Alkon loma-asuntoja ja mielekästä kerhotoimintaa.
  • Ateriakorvaus ja lisät: Maksamme jokaiselta toteutuneelta työpäivältä 8,56 € ateriakorvauksen sekä mahdolliset vuorokohtaiset lisät.
  • Kannustinpalkkiojärjestelmän johon koko henkilöstömme kuuluu. Kannustinjärjestelmän voimassaolosta ja periaatteista päätetään vuosittain erikseen.

Hakuprosessimme vaiheet:

  • Jätä hakemuksesi sujuvasti oheisen hakulinkin kautta, huomioithan ettemme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse. Saat tämän jälkeen sähköpostiisi kuittauksen hakemuksesi vastaanottamisesta.
  • Haun perusteella jatkoon menijät kutsumme Teams-keskusteluun rekrytoijan kanssa, jotta saamme puolin ja toisin tutustua toisiimme paremmin sekä kuulla mahdollisia kysymyksiäsi meille päin.
  • Teams haastatteluiden jälkeen seuraava vaiheemme ennen henkilövalintaa on tulevan esihenkilön tapaaminen henkilökohtaisen haastattelun merkeissä.


Innostuitko? Lähetäthän meille CV:si ja hakemuksesi viimeistään 20.9. Olemme lisänneet hakulomakkeeseemme muutamia ennakkokysymyksiä, joiden avulla toivomme saavamme vielä paremman kuvan siitä miksi juuri sinä olisit loistava lisä tiimiimme ja mikä sinua motivoi asiakaspalvelutyössä. Tehtävässä suunniteltu aloitusaika on 19.10 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja tehtävästä, työskentelystä Alkolla tai tukea hakuprosessiin? Ole rohkeasti yhteydessä, lisätietoja sinulle antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö Simo Lehikoinen, simo.lehikoinen@alko.fi tai rekrytoinnista vastaava Sanna-Leena Mäkiranta, sanna.makiranta@alko.fi.

Yhteinen Alko, minulle sopiva. Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus ovat Alkolle tärkeitä arvoja. Haluamme, että mahdollisimman moni voi kokea meidät työnantajana itselleen sopivaksi, ja työyhteisönä, jossa jokainen voi olla oma itsensä. Monenlainen osaaminen, erilaiset kyvyt ja kokemustaustat ovat Alkolle työyhteisönä iso rikkaus ja voimavara. Monimuotoisen työyhteisömme rakentamiseksi kannustammekin monenlaisista taustoista tulevia hakemaan meille töihin.

title: Wealth Management Associate - Bay Harbor, MI
description:
WHO WE ARE:

At Greenleaf Trust N.A., our teams are dedicated to providing the highest level of comprehensive wealth management services, trust administration and retirement plan services. We adhere to the highest standards

of fiduciary excellence while providing customized solutions and highly personal service to our clients.

SUMMARY:

Provides day-to-day support of the Senior Wealth Management Team. This role is responsible for executing trades, maintaining various financial planning systems, portfolio rebalancing and other items necessary to prepare for client meetings or questions. The Wealth Management Associate will provide general support to the various Senior Wealth Management Advisors but will also be provided with a mentor of whom they will shadow while completing all of the aforementioned responsibilities.

YOUR ROLE IN SERVING OUR CLIENTS INCLUDES:

• Leverage position to drive process improvement across wealth management, financial planning and trading platforms.

• Create a wealth management plan for prospective clients, which will serve as a framework to the relationship and highlight the objectives of the portfolio.

• Work closely with Client Centric Team (CCT) members to support client needs.

• Participation in projects as assigned.

• Provide general support to Senior Wealth Management Advisors as needed.

• All other duties as assigned

DEI COMMITMENT:

Greenleaf Trust is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, both within the organization itself, and the communities in which we serve. We continue to seek opportunities to give back and serve, work to ensure our actions are better and more inclusive and to provide opportunities for our team members to uphold the same expectations.

SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Employees are required to comply with all information and physical security policies and procedures

• Recurring training on information and physical security policies will be provided throughout your period of employment. Participation in these trainings is required.

• Refer to the Personnel Information Security Guide and the Information Security Policy Manual for further guidance on information security responsibilities and expectations.

MINIMUM EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• Bachelor's Degree and 1 year of experience in financial or investment management.

• Or equivalent education and experience.

TALENTS, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Strong communications skills.

• Strong thought leadership and analytical ability.

• Ability to develop and refine complex financial models, analytical processes and methodologies.

• Ability to collaborate with other team members to develop and grow a robust learning environment among the Wealth Management Team.

• Self-motivated, ability to work independently while fully functioning with a team environment.

• Ability to maintain a positive attitude while investment recommendations are reviewed and challenged by other Wealth Management Advisors.

• Ability to work in a complex environment and successfully perform with multiple priorities.

• Attention to detail

• Knowledge of sales process

• Financial planning

EQUIPMENT USED:

• Computer

• Various copiers, printers, and scanners

• Multi-line phone

• Audio Visual Equipment

• Smart Phone

CONTACTS:

• Wealth Management Associates have regular contact with most areas of the company; however, high contact would exist with Trust Relationship Officers and Team Service Coordinators as they are also part of the Client Centric Team.

• Wealth Management Associates also have regular contact with clients and prospects and their external

advisors.

This position requires a significant amount of time sitting and working on a computer, sitting in meetings and/or talking on a telephone.

Normal office environment, subject to constant interruptions, that is well lit, properly ventilated and handicap accessible.

description:
Job Title

Quality Assurance Manager

Reports to

Director of Quality

Direct Reports

None at this time


This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents. This position is designated as an FLSA exempt position.


Full time

To explore the full range of benefits please visit our website

$29.98-$37.03/hour - Placement in the range will be determined based on experience and other factors allowed by law.



GENERAL SUMMARY

The Quality Assurance (QA) Manager is responsible for ensuring that medical devices and pharmaceutical products comply with applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and company procedures.

This role supports the manufacturing, validation, and post-market activities by implementing and maintaining quality systems that ensure product safety, efficacy, and compliance.

The QA Manager works cross-functionally with Operations, Facilities, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to drive continuous improvement and maintain compliance with FDA, ISO, GMP, and other applicable regulations.


COMPANY STANDARDS

  • Maintains attendance and punctuality in order to complete assigned duties. This position performs work functions on site but may also travel to and work at any locations of operations.
  • Follows all quality and safety rules and regulations; wears and/or uses any required protective equipment while working; immediately reports any safety concerns or unsafe working conditions to QA and Operations Management.
  • Ensures compliance with all required regulations and guidelines in accordance with the JM Murray mission statement, policies and procedures. Adheres to all professional standards and governmental laws, rules and regulations. Reports any and all compliance related issues and concerns to the Director of Quality.
  • Manage the Company efforts in ISO to assure compliance against the International Organization for Standardization standards regarding all associated documentation
  • Manage the Company efforts within the framework of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) guidelines for products handled / produced by J.M. Murray Center, Inc.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Develop, maintain, and improve the Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with FDA, ISO, cGMP, and company quality standards.
  2. Responsible for developing, reviewing, and approving quality procedures, work instructions, and controlled documents. Serves as the primary document and change control coordinator for the organization.
  3. Initiate, investigate, and document product and process nonconformances and CAPA.
  4. Main quality representative responsible for operation activities such as batch record approval, Master Production/Control records and production documentation.
  5. Monitor manufacturing processes for compliance and effectiveness.
  6. Develop, execute, summarize, and approve validation plans/reports including; Process Validation, Product Validation, Product/Process Verification, Cleaning Validation (pharmaceuticals) and Test Method Validation.
  7. Support test method processes including; procedures, test methods and material management, manage the stability program and documentation.
  8. Support all supplier management activities including; qualification, supplier audit, and investigate/document supplier quality issues.
  9. Support management reviews and quality metric reporting.
  10. Conduct internal quality audits and support external audits by regulatory agencies and customers.
  11. Support inspection readiness activities and corrective action implementation.
  12. Investigate customer complaints and product quality issues.
  1. Support adverse event reporting and post-market surveillance programs.
  2. Meets quality assurance financial objectives by estimating requirements, preparing an annual budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
  3. Updates job knowledge by studying trends and developments in quality management, participating in educational opportunities, reading professional publications, maintaining personal networks, and participating in professional organizations.
  4. Enhances department and organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests, exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.
  5. Develop working relationships with departmental personnel to ensure open communications regarding any quality-related concerns / ideas
  6. Completes all required training and maintains required certifications; attends all assigned departmental and company meetings.
  7. Represents JM Murray and the JM Murray mission in a positive manner, treating people with respect and dignity.
  8. Performs additional duties and responsibilities, as assigned.

COLLABORATION

INTERNAL

  • JM Murray Management and Administration
  • JM Murray Operations employees and trainees

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, engineering or science required.
  • 8 or more proven years’ experience in Quality, Engineering, or related field in a regulated industry – Pharmaceutical and/or Medical Device required.
  • Must have demonstrated experience with ISO 9001, 21 CFR 210/211, 21 CFR 820 and ISO 13485
  • 5 or more years of experience in interpreting these regulations and translating to quality system processes and procedures.

PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS – Preferred but not Required

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)
  • ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
  • Lead Auditor certification (ISO 13485)
  • Experience with ERP and electronic QMS systems

KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS

  • Strong technical writing skills. Must be able to clearly document investigations, change control, etc.

  • Ability to coordinate with management on courses of action with minimal assistance using both written and verbal methods.
